title: Software Engineer II

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.
  
  
While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.
  
  
Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**A different kind of organization**

* High trust, transparency, and autonomy
* Small teams, high ownership, flat structures
* Radical compensation transparency
* Sense of ownership in collective success
* Work with exceptional people who deeply care about their craft

**The role**

As a Lead Consultant, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.

**What the work looks like**

We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:

* Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.
* Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.
* Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.
* Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.

The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.

**What you'll do**

Frame Problems & Propose Solutions

* Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.
* Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.
* Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.

Lead Through Technical Excellence

* Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review.
* Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.
* Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems and the practices that keep them that way.

Influence, Advise, and align

* Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory.
* Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams
* Converge competing priorities into a path forward.
* Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go.

Operate Across Technology Domains

Distributed systems, data engineering, AI & agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. Depth in few areas; breadth across, and appreciation for trade-offs in context.

**You'll thrive here if**

* You reach for the simplest solution that gets the job done and distrust accidental complexity.
* You think in systems, not isolated parts.
* You stay calm when the path is unclear and build clarity for those around you.
* You move easily between the org-level picture and the technical detail.
* You're curious by default and pick up new domains fast.
* You'd rather be in the room with a customer solving a real problem.

**What we're looking for**

* 12+ years building software systems in complex environments.
* Strong engineering fundamentals; expert in at least one language, ideally polyglot.
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale.
* Deep grasp of architecture, system design, and engineering trade-offs.
* Direct experience working with customers and business stakeholders.

title: Associate / Specialist, Software Technology

**Group/Division**

We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. * Support product releases, customer escalations, field issues, and continuous product improvement efforts.
* Act as a technical integrator across teams to help drive successful product execution and divisional objectives.
* Mentor engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and engineering best practices.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Leverage AI productivity tools and modern engineering approaches to improve development efficiency and product quality.
* Identify opportunities for technical innovation, automation, and architecture improvements.
* Promote engineering excellence through robust design, code quality, testing, and maintainability practices.

**Travel**

* Travel to KLA and customer sites globally as required to support product development, deployment, customer engagement, and technology advancement.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with C++ and Python development.
* Experience working in Linux environments.
* Familiarity with distributed systems, high-performance computing (HPC), or large-scale software platforms.
* Experience with AI productivity and development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar technologies.

* Ability to influence and lead through technical expertise.
* Passion for solving challenging engineering problems.
* Continuous learner with curiosity for emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Collaborative team player capable of working effectively across global organizations.
* Ability to energize teams and drive outcomes in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software development experience delivering complex software products.
* Strong expertise in C# and .NET application development.
* Strong software design, architecture, and object-oriented programming skills.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis capabilities in complex software environments.
* Solid understanding of Windows internals and .NET runtime concepts.
* Thorough knowledge of software engineering principles, SDLC, and software quality practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven ability to work effectively in global cross-functional teams.

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including WiFi Firmware, Driver, Cloud, RDK-B, and Product Engineering teams for end-to-end feature integration.
* Analyze WLAN performance issues and develop solutions to improve throughput, roaming, latency, and device connectivity.
* Develop and maintain networking applications utilizing TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, NAT, QoS, and routing protocols.
* Implement WiFi management features using TR-181, TR-069, EasyMesh, Multi-AP, and Broadband Forum standards.

* Contribute to software design, code reviews, architecture discussions, and product enhancements.

* Minimum 4-8 years of experience in WLAN/WiFi Software Development.

* Strong understanding of Linux networking stack and socket programming.
* Experience with hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, cfg80211, mac80211, and wireless networking components.
* Knowledge of EasyMesh, Multi-AP, Band Steering, Client Steering, and Mesh Networking concepts.
* Familiarity with RDK-B architecture, CCSP framework, WebPA, and TR-181 data models is preferred.
* Experience with debugging tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, gdb, and Linux tracing utilities.

• Strong working knowledge of model selection, prompt engineering, grounding, agent evaluation, and cost monitoring.

• Familiarity with software engineering best practices including Git, CI/CD pipelines, testing, debugging, and secure development principles.

About us

InfoBeans, founded in 2000, is a publicly listed company on the NSE & BSE in India, specializing in AI-first software development and implementation for enterprise clients to solve complex business challenges. Creating WOW! is not just a tagline for us; it’s our religion!

title: Software Development Engineer - 3
description:
AssetPlus is redefining the future of wealth management. We're a fast-scaling SaaS fintech platform powering mutual fund distributors (MFDs) and financial advisors with tools that modernise how investments are managed. Our mission is to build India's best assisted wealth management platform, helping millions of households achieve their financial goals.
  
  
Engineering at AssetPlus is a growth led, high-velocity team of ~18 engineers organized into three product pods. We ship on a modern, AI-enabled Node.js + TypeScript + MongoDB stack, own our systems in production, and hold a high technical and cultural bar. If you want to solve meaningful problems at scale with real ownership, this is the place.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a deeply hands-on SDE-3 who owns features end-to-end and raises the quality bar within a pod. You bring strong technical judgment, speed, clarity and simplicity to everything you build. You will be a core builder inside one product pod: designing services, writing production Node.js + TypeScript, shaping MongoDB schemas, debugging across backend, React and Flutter, and keeping the systems you own reliable. You will use AI as a cognitive partner to move faster without lowering the bar.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Systems**

* Design and build scalable, resilient services within your pod's domain.
* Contribute to system design reviews and argue trade-offs with first-principles reasoning.
* Decide what to build vs reuse vs adopt open-source, and explain the call.
* Follow and strengthen the architecture patterns the team has agreed on.

**Hands-On Engineering**

* Write high-quality Node.js + TypeScript code - readable, tested, production-grade.
* Design efficient MongoDB schemas and build complex aggregations.
* Debug issues across React, Flutter and Backend, down to the infra and DB layer.
* Leverage AI capabilities and develop at a high pace with good taste.

**AI Driven Engineering**

* Use AI as a cognitive partner to accelerate coding, debugging, design and decision-making.
* Orchestrate models, tools, context and workflows into a productive AI-powered engineering loop.
* Continuously adopt new AI capabilities to compound speed and improve system quality.
* Bring AI native practices into your pod's day-to-day workflow.

**Reliability & Support**

* Monitor the systems you own and catch issues early.
* Respond to critical incidents with urgency - including off-hours when it matters.
* Drive root-cause analysis, performance improvements and observability.

**Developer Experience & Quality**

* Contribute to improving developer workflows, tooling and automation.
* Maintain high standards around clarity, testing, security and simplicity.
* Advocate for minimal, robust and maintainable engineering.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and review their work closely.
* Communicate decisions clearly and confidently.
* Be approachable, energetic and easy to build with.

**What we are looking for;**
Must have
  
  

* 6–8 years of full stack experience with a backend-heavy core (experience range is indicative - we hire for ownership, not tenure)
* Strong Node.js + TypeScript in production; you have owned services end-to-end, not just contributed
* Solid MongoDB - schema design, indexing, complex aggregations
* Built and operated systems under real load; comfortable being on the hook when they break
* Strong debugging across backend, frontend and DB layer
* Pragmatic engineering judgment - simple > clever; sound build vs reuse vs open-source calls
* Strong communicator - can clearly explain a system you owned and the decisions behind it

**Strongly Preferred**

* Hands-on AWS - CloudWatch, ECS, Amplify, Lambda, SQS, SES
* React and/or Flutter exposure - enough to debug across the stack
* Fintech, wealth-tech or SEBI-regulated product experience
* Daily use of AI coding tools as a real productivity multiplier, not a novelty
* Experience mentoring juniors and running meaningful code reviews
* CI/CD, Docker and GitHub-based workflows in a fast-shipping team

The Container security remediation officer (docker) is a software developer specialized and dedicated to the security management and integrity of the Docker image ecosystem. Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Image Lifecycle & Security Remediation

* Continuous Improvement: Applydeveloperbest practices (e.g., SOLID, Craft) to ensure images are not only secure but also maintainable and scalable.
* Validation & Deployment: Upon delegation, update imagereferencesand trigger CI/CD toolchains tovalidatethe technical behavior and security integrity of new images.
* Operational Governance & Reporting
* Activity Tracking: Organize and track all assigned activities, providing weekly feedback and local KPI production to the Cloud DevOps COE team.
* Catalog Management: Maintainand regularly update the list of all available images (at least bi-monthly) and communicate changes to developer teams.
* Proactive Alerting: Activelymonitorand alert development teamsregardingthe use of obsolete or non-compliant images to prevent securityregressions.
* Task Prioritization: Classify and organize requests and topics to ensure alignment with priority subjects and COE objectives.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Developer Advocacy: Provide functional and technical support to users during the development, build, scanning, and releasing phases.
* Global Collaboration: Assistsubsidiaries and partners during the onboarding phase to ensure seamless integration into the secure container ecosystem.

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  
**Specific Qualifications**

* Containerization: Expert-level knowledge of Docker and container security management.
* Software Development: Proven experience in software engineering (specifically in Java, .NET, or Python) to enable deep-dive vulnerability remediation.
* Security & Vulnerability Management: Expert-level knowledge of identifying, analyzing, and fixing security flaws within application stacks.
* Toolchain Proficiency: Practical experience with CI/CD toolchains and security scanning tools.
* IT Infrastructure: Strong general knowledge of IT infrastructure and cloud environments.

**Technical Skills**
Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)
  
  

* Docker (expert level)
* Java,.Net or Python Developer
* CI/CD toolchain

**Behavioral Skills**

* Analytical Ability: Ability to classify complex requests and prioritize key subjects effectively.
* Organizational Skills & Rigor: Highly disciplined in tracking activities,maintainingdocumentation, and meeting reporting deadlines.
* Collaboration & Teamwork: Ability to work effectively within an Agile organization and act as a "Developer Advocate."
* Resilience & Adaptability: Capable of managing changing priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Communication: Ability to communicate technical security requirements clearly to diverse developer teams.

Education Level: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Computer Science
  
  
Experience level: 5+ years

* Integrate software components, libraries, and auto-generated code into deployable software images and flash files.

* Integrate calibration, configuration, and parameter datasets into embedded control applications.

* Analyse test results and implement corrective actions as required.

**Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting**

* Identify, investigate, and resolve software defects and system integration issues.
* Perform root cause analysis of software, controls, and system-level failures.
* Utilize debugging and diagnostic tools to troubleshoot embedded applications.
* Support field issue resolution and continuous software improvement initiatives.

title: Ethernet Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Automotive Ethernet & Networking Software Engineer (Android/Linux IVI)**

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a highly skilled Automotive Ethernet & Networking Software Engineer with strong expertise in Linux and Android-based infotainment systems. The role focuses on designing, developing, and optimizing Ethernet and networking components within IVI platforms, ensuring high performance, reliability, and compliance with automotive standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop Ethernet and networking software components for In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) systems
* Implement and optimize networking features on
  **Linux and Android (AOSP) platforms**
* Work on Automotive Ethernet technologies including switch configuration and interface integration
* Develop and maintain network protocols across L2 and L3 layers
* Analyze requirements and translate them into scalable, high-performance solutions
* Perform debugging, packet analysis, and troubleshooting using tools like
  **Wireshark/pcap**
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware, BSP, and system integration teams
* Ensure compliance with automotive standards and certifications (e.g., Open Alliance TC8)
* Contribute to system performance tuning, stability, and reliability improvements

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related engineering field
* 4–7 years of experience in Ethernet and networking software development
* Strong programming skills in
  **C, C++, and/or Java**
* Hands-on experience with
  **Android AOSP and Linux-based infotainment platforms**
* Solid understanding of
  **Linux and Android networking stack**

**Core Technical Expertise**

* Automotive Ethernet switch development and configuration
* Interfaces and protocols:
  **MII, RGMII, SGMII, 100/1000BASE-T1, PCIe, SERDES**
* Networking concepts:
  **VLANs, L2 Bridging, L3 Routing**
* Protocols:
  **TCP/IP, UDP, SOME/IP, IPv4, IPv6**
* Experience with
  **packet capture and analysis (pcap tools)**
* Exposure to
  **Open Alliance TC8 certification testing**
* Knowledge of AVB/TSN standards:
* IEEE 802.1AS (Time Synchronization)
* IEEE 1722 (AV Transport Protocol)
* IEEE 802.1Qav (Traffic Shaping)
* IEEE 802.1Qat (Stream Reservation)
* Experience in
  **Media Clock Recovery configuration and troubleshooting**
* Experience in
  **porting and working with Open AVNU stack**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in automotive domain (IVI, connected vehicle platforms)
* Familiarity with real-time communication and time-sensitive networking (TSN)
* Exposure to performance optimization and low-latency networking systems

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex technical issues
* Effective communication and stakeholder collaboration skills
* Ability to work in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

**Why Join**

* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge automotive networking technologies
* Exposure to next-gen connected vehicle and IVI ecosystems
* Collaborative engineering culture with high technical ownership

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
VNDLY, a Workday company, is a next-generation vendor management SaaS platform designed for procurement executives, talent acquisition teams, suppliers, and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to optimize contingent workforce management. We develop cloud software that simplifies talent sourcing and acquisition across various channels, including staffing agencies, job boards, and freelance management systems. Our aim is to create intuitive software that enables customers to efficiently acquire top talent (contractors or full-time employees) through data-driven insights and transparent dashboards.
  
  
As part of Workday, we are committed to becoming the most customer-centric enterprise software company in the world. We prioritize enabling our customers to connect to the talent they need to excel, achieved by fostering an exceptional engineering team committed to code quality and innovative design.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Development Engineer, you will be joining a team in Chennai responsible for maintaining and building our pay-related features. This is a hands-on-keyboard role where you will not only build features but also own the design, scalability, and resilience of critical services.
  
  
You will tackle complex challenges related to how contingent workers are onboarded, managed, and paid, working on key features like Jobs, Worker Provisioning, Contracts, and Integrations. You will be a key voice in our architectural decisions and will guide the team in building robust solutions using our stack: Python (backend), React (frontend), and AWS.
  
  
**About You**
This role is for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex software problems. The ideal candidate will join an established office of 15 VNDLY colleagues and will be at the forefront of building our engineering presence as part of Workday's larger investment in Chennai!
  
  
Beyond a desire for solving complex and writing high-quality, efficient code, this person must be an exceptional communicator, acting as a key technical connection between our established U.S. teams and the new Chennai office. The ability to work independently, while also working effectively within a large, distributed team, is essential.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years shown experience in software development, including experience in designing, building, and maintaining RESTful web services and working with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Deep proficiency in Python and experience with at least one Python web framework (e.g., Django, Flask).
* Strong experience with JavaScript frameworks, specifically React.js.

**Other Qualifications**

* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools (e.g., Git).
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda).
* Knowledge of SaaS applications, multi-tenant architectures, and DevOps/CI/CD practices.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.

Workday is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.
  
  
Further, pursuant to applicable local ordinances, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
You may view the Workday's Pay Transparency Policy, and Equal Employment Opportunity is the Law notice, by clicking on their corresponding links.
  
  
Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans during our application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at accommodations@workday.com.
  
  
**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply
**spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field**
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.

description:
**Description**
As a Software Development Engineer you will engage with an
  
  
experienced cross-disciplinary team to conceive, design and
  
  
implement innovative consumer products. Vertically your
  
  
ownership can span across device framework, network stack,
  
  
OTA , setup, controllers, drivers, and low level wireless
  
  
controllers. Horizontally you will be given an opportunity to
  
  
work across multiple Echo devices. You are expected to have
  
  
strong working knowledge of Linux and RTOS. You will work
  
  
closely with the engineering leaders from cross functional
  
  
teams, technical managers, hardware, operations, application,
  
  
platform and quality assurance teams. You must be responsive,
  
  
flexible, and able to succeed within an open and collaborative
  
  
peer environment. The team is responsible for the entire
  
  
firmware related user experience and use cases.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems.
  
  

* Experience in embedded development in C/C++
* Implement the right metrics, debug tools and integrate with backend solutions to continuously measure and improve on our solutions
* Development experience on Linux and RTOS platforms
* Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* Work with cross functional teams to implement technical solutions for desired features and address customer issues.
* Work with teams to improve and tailor existing drivers, stack, memory footprint and application code to our needs
* Work with the hardware team to ensure correct exercising of hardware and software architecture.

**About The Team**
The Amazon Devices team designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics, including the best-selling Kindle family of products. We have also produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, Amazon Dash Buttons, and Amazon Echo Family of devices. We are the team that brought you the Echo Show and Echo Spot, touch-screen enabled Alexa devices that supports video calling, music, weather, and more
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of embedded firmware development experience
* Experience in embedded development in C/C++
* Experience in computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis)
* Experience in one or more of these areas: cameras, sensors and associated algorithm development
* Experience in embedded software design, development and debugging preferably on ARM based platforms
* Experience with RTOS and embedded Linux development
* Board level experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in embedded wireless systems, or experience in computer architecture
* Performed low level board bring-up or developed HAL code or BSPs for custom hardware
* Deep hands-on experience in Linux/RTOS framework/drivers and Wi-Fi & Bluetooth stacks

title: Feature Lead - Technology - GBS IND
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation.

10+ years\*\* of experience in designing, developing, and deploying highly scalable applications and platforms.
  
  
Strong foundation in \*\*computer science fundamentals\*\*, including data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
  
  
Proven experience in \*\*managing tech debt/modernizing technologies\*\* for scalability and performance.
  
  
Advanced proficiency with programming languages such as \*\*Java, Scala, or Golang\*\* (at least two).

Experience in \*\*CI/CD development environments and tools\*\*, including Git, Maven, Jenkins, etc.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**

Work

Belonging

Backend engineers at Confluent, work on a set of diverse and complex challenges, such as building foundational cloud frameworks and services that power all components of the platform in the Cloud. We are building a multi-tenant, multi-cloud, cloud-native compute substrate to enable seamless data integration across Confluent Cloud.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you think strategically and you help drive end-to-end technical delivery from the customer experience to scaling internal operations. You leverage your growing expertise in cloud-native, distributed systems to help take our execution platform to the next level. You care deeply about the key operational aspects (availability, reliability, performance, monitoring, capacity planning, and disaster recovery) of our Connect Platform, helping ensure we provide a highly available, resilient, and secure environment that our largest customers can rely on to run their mission-critical data pipelines.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Build mission-critical infrastructure: Develop, test, and operationalize high-performance, scalable, and resilient backend services.
* Build and evolve Kafka connectors: Design, develop, and maintain Kafka Connect connectors for integrating with external data systems.

Master's Degree

* Educational background: BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience contributing to large-scale, highly available, low-latency, and high-throughput data systems.

* Experience using mainframe-to-Java, Python, or .NET transformation tools and modernization methodologies
* Experience rewriting IBM utilities such as SORT, IDCAMS, IEBGENER, or IEBCOPY using modern languages or frameworks
* Experience modernizing integration patterns across batch, message queue, transaction, API, or event-driven architectures

* Experience with LLM-based code understanding or prompt engineering workflows for legacy code analysis
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform for target-state hosting
* Experience with microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, or API management platforms
* Experience with Business Rules Management Systems such as Drools, IBM Operational Decision Manager, or Blaze Advisor
* Experience supporting modernization programs in banking, insurance, government, or healthcare

title: Sr Associate, MAPP Developer
description:
**Role Summary**
Pfizer Digital & Technology is a customer-oriented, front-line organization with a vision to Win the Digital Race in Pharma and Unleash the Power of our Colleagues by creating compelling digital experiences for our internal and external audiences.
  
  
MAPP (My Anti-corruption Policy and Procedures) is Pfizer’s compliance platform designed to uphold the company’s commitment to ethical business practices and adherence to global anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws. The MAPP solution provides a centralized digital framework for managing, documenting, and approving interactions with healthcare professionals (HCPs), government officials, and third-party entities across global markets. The solution is a cornerstone of Pfizer’s compliance infrastructure, ensuring that all business activities are conducted with integrity and transparency.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for developing, testing, and supporting robust, scalable, and secure Appian applications that support critical business processes across the enterprise. This role serves as an experienced hands-on Appian developer, delivering solutions that align with enterprise standards, performance expectations, and security frameworks under the guidance of the Pfizer development lead. This role partners closely with Product Owners, Security, and cross‑functional Agile teams to deliver high‑quality applications, integrations, and reusable components.
  
  
The position requires solid, hands-on proficiency in Appian platform capabilities—including process models, interfaces, rules, data design, integrations, and modern low‑code patterns—and sound judgment in applying established best practices to create maintainable, future‑proof solutions. In addition to hands‑on development, this role contributes to design discussions, and stays current with new Appian features and industry trends to support continuous improvement
  
  
In this role, you will need to work collaboratively with individuals across teams and functions to achieve the business outcomes.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with product owners, analysts, and senior developers to gather and refine requirements, and help convert them into technical scope, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Identify integration touchpoints and dependencies (APIs, data sources), and contribute to effort estimates and sprint planning.
* Contribute to the design of end‑to‑end Appian solutions (data model/CDTs & Records, SAIL UX, process models, security model) with guidance from senior developers, aligned to best practices and enterprise standards.
* Implement integrations (REST/SOAP, RDBMS, third‑party connectors) following documented design patterns and performance considerations.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER
  
  
**Location: Chennai | Type: Fulltime**
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.
  
  
From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.
  
  
We are proud to be a Great Place to Work certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people s lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.
  
  
You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.
  
  
This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You Ll Do**
**Problem / Opportunity Discovery**

* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.

**Build (fast) with AI**

* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.

**Test, Deploy, Productionize**

* Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users.
* Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless chosen for fit, not preference.
* Treat evals as a first-class discipline: hands-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* End-to-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses.
* Cloud-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave and where they break and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them.
* A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure.
* AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:
  
  

* A people-first culture - Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
* Smart, purposeful collaboration - Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges
* Balance that lasts - We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life
* Room to grow - Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you
* Meaningful rewards - Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential

**Ready to Apply?**
Let s build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to:
  
  
*shubhi.tiwari@newpage.io*

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees:**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software gets created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate it. Without consistent governance, organizations end up shipping code they can't explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees Unify is a governance layer that works with the tools a customer already runs, instead of asking them to replace them. It makes every change, human or AI, visible and accountable before it reaches production, and enforces the same policy across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at cloudbees.com (https://www.cloudbees.com).
  
  
**About the team:**
Our department, internally called "Faster, Safer Releases," has three areas: CDRO Classic (CloudBees CD/RO, our established, self-managed release orchestration product, still very much serving customers today), Unify Release Orchestration (Unify RO, its newer sibling, delivered as a SaaS), and Unify FM (feature management). You'd help shape the technical direction of Unify RO alongside the engineers already building it, who are rethinking what release orchestration can look like rather than porting CDRO Classic.
  
  
You'll join a core team of experienced engineers, and many more people contribute to the RO codebase beyond that: engineers from other teams across the department often land on it. You won't manage anyone. You'll be a go-to technical contact for RO work happening outside the core team, and you'll share accountability with the core team for the codebase's long-term health, including bridging to CDRO Classic customers curious about Unify RO and pushing internal dogfooding so CloudBees' own teams ship their own PRs faster and safer, alongside Unify FM.
  
  
**What you'll do:**
**Help shape where Unify RO goes**

* Learn the current RO architecture from the people who built it, well enough to form an evidence-based view: what's solid, what's accumulating risk, and which ideas from CDRO Classic are worth carrying forward.
* Help sequence the technical roadmap so the team ships value every few weeks, not a multi-quarter rewrite. You'll work closely with the RO product manager, as a conversation with the whole team rather than a two-person channel: product owns what and why, engineering owns how and in what order.
* Stay hands-on with hard problems, especially ones that cross team boundaries and have no natural owner today.

**Make the team stronger, not more dependent on you**

* Work as a peer with strong engineers, on the core team and on other teams when they're on RO, as ready to be persuaded as to persuade.
* Bring context from across the department and from customers. Most technical calls stay with the engineers closest to the work: your job is to make those calls better informed, not to collect them.
* Give candid, useful design and code review, and expect the same back.

**Build the bridge to CDRO Classic and the business**

* Talk to CDRO Classic customers interested in Unify RO. Bring back what actually matters to them.
* Drive adoption of RO pipelines inside CloudBees itself: help other teams ship PRs from dev to production faster and safer, combining progressive delivery with feature flagging, in partnership with Unify FM.

**Make quality the default, not an afterthought**

* Keep testing, service boundaries, and release discipline strong as the team and roadmap evolve.
* Pay down tech debt as you go instead of letting it pile up behind the next feature.
* Push observability toward finding root causes fast.
* Make it possible for other teams to move fast in the RO codebase without breaking it: through tooling, clear specs (including for AI-written changes), onboarding, and code review.
* Write down architectural decisions and the reasoning behind them, so nobody has to rediscover it in six months.

**Requirements**
**What we're looking for:**
**Must have**

* 10+ years of experience, with principal or staff+ scope you can point to: you've joined a complex, live system and its team and measurably improved it together, including the sequencing and trade-off calls involved.
* You lead through influence and technical credibility, not formal authority. If what attracts you to this role is the chance to "decide" things, this isn't the right fit: every engineer here, principal included, asks good questions and earns agreement rather than pulling rank.
* Strong opinions, loosely held. Earning agreement means forming a real point of view and arguing for it, then dropping it fast when someone shows you better evidence.
* The same goes outside the team: you're comfortable talking directly to customers about technical trade-offs.
* Hands-on backend depth building and operating microservices on AWS, ideally in Go. Strong experience in a comparable backend language, with appetite to go deep in Go, also works.
* The distributed-systems depth that goes with it: concurrency, event-driven architectures, message buses, and what actually breaks in each of them in production.
* Hands-on use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) in your own work, not secondhand opinions. You know where they're good and bad, and that shapes how you think about architecture, review, and the governance problem Unify RO exists to solve.
* A sense of humor. You'll need one some days, and it'll help on the good ones too.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with CI/CD systems, workflow/pipeline engines, or developer platforms.
* Experience with progressive delivery or feature flagging.
* Java. CDRO Classic is written in Java, and knowing it shortens the ramp on deciding what to keep.

**Who this is for:**
You like joining a system that's already moving, built by people who know it better than you will on day one. You'd rather improve what's working than rewrite it from scratch, and you're energized by a role that's equal parts deep technical work, customer conversations, and getting other CloudBees teams to use what the team builds. Sharp and a little irreverent beats technically flawless but humorless, as long as you still ship.

title: Visual Basic Developer
description:

develop, maintain, and optimize enterprise-grade Excel/VBA automation solutions.

The role will work closely with business and process teams to understand

requirements, automate complex processes, improve operational efficiency, and

support large-scale legacy process migration and automation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Excel-based automation solutions for complex business processes.

automation opportunities, and deliver solutions that improve productivity,

accuracy, quality, and cycle time.

support automation, migration, and modernization initiatives where

applicable.

Technical Expertise | Problem Solving | Business Process Understanding |

title: GenAI Lead
description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.
  
  
**Job Overview:**
We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled
**Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer**
to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership:

+ Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
+ Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

* Solution Development:

+ Architect, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art LLMs and generative AI models
+ Develop and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific fine-tuning.
+ Develop and deploy generative AI models, particularly focusing on ChatGPT, using Python on Azure or AWS Platform or .Net on Azure platform
+ Ensure scalability, performance, and security of AI solutions deployed in production.
+ Integration and Deployment:

* API Development:

+ Ability to define and deliver API access for GenAI services, facilitating integration with other systems and applications.
+ Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and services.
+ Utilize cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) to deploy and manage AI models and APIs.
+ Leverage MLOps practices for continuous model monitoring, retraining, and improvement.

* Data Strategy and Preparation:

+ Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
+ Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.

* Innovation and Research:

+ Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.
+ Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, libraries, and platforms for project requirements.

* Stakeholder Collaboration:

+ Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and UX designers to define AI-powered product features and use cases.
+ Present technical concepts, project progress, and AI capabilities to non-technical audiences.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML, such as Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Hands on experience in any of LLMs such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT Models , Gemini, Llama 2 ,Claude 2 ,Grok
* Hands on experience in any of the agentic frameworks like LangChain, Semantic kernel, AutoGen, CrewAi
* Hands on experience using any of vector database like Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Faiss
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
* Strong expertise in LLMs and generative AI frameworks like OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar platforms.
* Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts, including tokenization, embeddings, and sequence-to-sequence models.
* Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline management and automation tools, particularly within the Azure DevOps environment. Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools is also important
* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution
* Minimum of 6 years of extensive full-time experience in Data Analysis, Statistics, Machine Learning, or Computer Science
* Proven track record of leading AI projects from inception to production.
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF).
* Certifications in AI/ML or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning).

title: Exasol Evergreen Talents Hunt Challenge
description:
**Exasol Evergreen Talents Hunt Challenge**

**Location: Chennai, India**

🚀
**Why Exasol? Why Now?**

Exasol is a high-performance analytics database built for data at scale, for the new AI era. At Exasol, our engineers solve hard problems across distributed systems, performance, reliability and real-world customer workloads needed for this new AI era.

The new AI era requires creators and builders who enjoy building robust technology and tackling complex technical challenges. We are building an evergreen talent community that enjoys doing so.

Here is an opportunity for you to be part of this evergreen talent community. Yes, it’s not a challenge for a job opening, but more a fodder for the hungry minds, a challenging teaser to the builder of the new AI era, that may lead to new opportunities in Exasol.

💼
**How It Works?**

1. Go through the OpenSource Challenge listed below
2. Show us how you think, build and solve it
3. Enjoy handsome rewards for best solutions
4. Get into our Exasol Evergreen talent community.
5. As part of Exasol Evergreen talent community, you will be prioritized for roles opening within Exasol. You will also be invited to participate in their meetups, conferences, webinars and any other events. You could be eligible for testing Exasol pre-releases

**🎯The Challenge - Welcome to Exasol's Opensource Challenge**

1. Pick a public open source project that is not hosted by Exasol
2. The project must have at least 100 stars on GitHub
3. Make it compatible with or add a feature for Exasol (e.g., by contributing a connector to the upstream project)
4. Add automatic integration tests
5. The upstream maintainers must accept and merge your contribution
6. Make sure you will be able to maintain it
7. Present the result

💡
**Example Projects**

The list below is just to show what kind of upstream projects we mean. Participants to not have to pick those. There are hundreds of potential projects out in the world.

* GitHub - xo/usql: Universal command-line interface for SQL databases
* GitHub - dbeaver/cloudbeaver: Cloud Database Manager
* GitHub - kayak/pypika: PyPika is a python SQL query builder that exposes the full richness of the SQL language using a syntax that reflects the resulting query. PyPika excels at all sorts of SQL queries but is especially useful for data analysis.

✅
**The Dos**

1. Integrate with an existing open source project
2. Ensure it is getting accepted upstream
3. Make it maintainable. This is the most critical point
4. Even if you maintain an upstream project, you can participate

❌
**The Donts**

1. Don’t start a new open source project just to integrate Exasol
2. Maintainability should not require rewriting and more work

📊
**Evaluation**

If someone manages to fulfill all criteria of the challenge, we will do a code and documentation review, to gauge how well that was executed.

Criteria (in descending order of importance):

1. Security
2. User experience
3. Performance
4. Maintainability

Winners (multiple categories) will be declared post evaluation and prizes given.

📈
**What’s in it for You**

Completing a challenge gives you the opportunity to connect with Exasol, demonstrate your skills and ability to build new things, and become part of the broader global data community.

**🎯 Ready to Launch Your Career with Exasol?**

If you’re hungry to learn, unafraid to fail, and energized by the idea of helping the world’s leading organizations unlock the power of their data — we want to hear from you.

Apply now and be part of Exasol’s next chapter.

**About Exasol**

Take the next step in your career journey. Visit
www.exasol.com
to explore our current job openings, and follow us on
LinkedIn
to see what it is like to work at Exasol.

Exasol is a proud equal opportunities employer. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive working environment and therefore base all our employment selection decisions, within all aspects of our business, on experience, skill, and integrity. We strongly encourage applicants from all walks to life to apply for our positions, irrespective of age, sex, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, etc.

title: Princ Engr-AI Science
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Principal Engineer to lead the architecture and design our AI/ML practice, particularly focused on cognitive and agentic systems. In this role, you will spearhead the development and implementation of cutting-edge solutions, leveraging your deep expertise to drive innovation and establish industry best practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end AI solutions, including data pipelines, model training, deployment, monitoring, and optimization.
* Develop technical high level and low level architecture for generative and agentic systems
* Lead and mentor a high performing team of data scientists and AI/ML engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.
* Stay abreast of the latest advancements and trends in Generative/Agentic AI, continuously evaluating and integrating emerging technologies.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and business stakeholders, to translate business requirements into innovative AI/ML solutions.
* Champion the adoption of AI/ML best practices, ensuring the development and deployment of secure, reliable, and ethical AI systems.

**What We're Looking For**
**You'll need to have**

* Bachelors degree or six or more years of work experience.
* Twelve or more years of experience in architecting, designing, and implementing large-scale AI/ML systems in a production environment, including implementation of large-scale NLP Projects and Fine tuning & Evaluation of LLMs for downstream tasks such as text generation, Classification, summarization, question answering, entity extraction etc.
* Proven track record of designing, developing and deploying agentic solutions at scale with measurable results mapped to business goals
* Ability to represent the team in leadership forums, and elevate the AI practice by creating next gen solutions and evangelizing best practices
* Ability to guide the team to correctly analyze cognitive insights and leverage unstructured conversational data to create transformative, intelligent, context aware and adaptive AI systems
* Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning model development & deployment from scratch in Python.
* Working knowledge of NLP frameworks and libraries like NLTK, Spacy, Transformers, Pytorch, Tensorflow, hugging face api’s.
* Working knowledge of various supervised and unsupervised ML algorithms . Should know the various data preprocessing techniques and its impact on algorithm's accuracy, precision and recall.
* Knowledge & Implementation Experience of Deep Learning i.e Convolutional Neural Nets (CNN), Recursive Neural Nets (RNN) & Long Short Term Memory (LSTM), Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN), Deep Reinforcement Learning.
* Experience with RESTful, JSON API services.
* Working knowledge on these: Word embeddings, TF-IDF, Tokenization, N-Grams, Stemmers, lemmatization, Part of speech tagging, entity resolution, ontology, lexicology, phonetics, intents, entities, and context.
* Experience in analyzing Live Chat/call conversation with agents.
* Expertise in Python, Sql, PySpark, Scala and/or other languages and tools.
* Understanding of validation framework for generative model output and perspective on future ready systems to scale validation
* Familiarity with GPU/CPU architecture and distributed computing and general infra needs to scale Gen AI models
* Ability to provide technical thought leadership on model architecture, delivery, monitoring, measurement and model lifecycle best practices.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience with MLOps tools and best practices.
* Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects.
* Familiarity with telecommunications industry data and use cases.

**Even Better If You Have**

* Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

description:
**Job Description**
**We are Omnissa!**
The world is evolving fast, and organizations everywhere—from corporations to schools—are under immense pressure to provide flexible, work-from-anywhere solutions. They need an IT infrastructure that empowers employees and customers to access applications from any device, on any cloud, all while maintaining top-tier security. That’s where Omnissa comes in.
  
  
The Omnissa Platform is the first AI-driven digital work platform that enables smart, seamless and secure work experiences from anywhere. It uniquely integrates multiple industry-leading solutions including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance through common data, identity, administration, and automation services. Built on the vision of autonomous workspaces - self configuring, self-healing, and self-securing - Omnissa continuously adapts to the way people work, delivering personalized and engaging employee experiences, while optimizing security, IT operations and costs. we're experiencing rapid growth—and this is just the beginning of our journey!
  
  
At Omnissa, we’re driven by a shared mission to maximize value for our customers. Our five Core Values guide us:
**Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value**
—all with the aim of achieving shared success for our clients and our team.
  
  
As a global private company with over 4,000 employees, we’re always looking for passionate, talented individuals to join us. If you're ready to make an impact and help shape the future of work, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
**What is the opportunity?:**
You have an analytical mind and a passion for the craft of software engineering, and you love solving problems and learning new things. Technologies come and go, but that excites you because of the endless possibilities it creates. You are looking for an opportunity to work for a company whose software is utilized by every Fortune 500 company and significantly impacts every industry. You want to be a part of a collaborative environment whose teams care about the product they are creating, how they create it, and the impact it has on customers’ business objectives.
  
  
**As a Member of Technical Staff . Skills required are**
:
  
  

* Automation experience using Python.
* Automation experience with C++ is a plus
* Good understanding of software testing methodologies - Unit Testing, Integration Testing, End to End Testing, Performance and Interop testing.
* Test concepts like test suites, test cases, parameterized testing, mocks & stubs.
* Windows/macOS event monitoring
* Static code analysis and code coverage tools like SonarQube & CodeQL.
* Able to write and maintain test scripts in bash, PowerShell & Python

**What will you bring to Omnissa?**

* 5+ years of experience in software engineering.
* Hands-on with test frameworks like Google Test, Nunit, Python Behave.
* Running automated tests in Docker containers and Virtual Machines.
* Incorporating automated testing in CI/CD pipelines using Github integrations such as Github actions and Github workflows.
* Debugging & fixing issues in CI/CD pipelines.
* Collaborate with developers, identify test scenarios from feature specifications. Document and create test cases in TestRails.

* Git, Github Actions, bazel, Shell scripting in bash and PowerShell, Yaml, Docker, Vi

Chennai

This role offers a balanced arrangement, with the expectation of working 3 days a week in our local office and the flexibility to work from home for the remaining days. It is essential that you reside within a reasonable commuting distance of the office location for the in-office workdays.

This role reports to the Engineering Manager, DEEM. The team is based out of Chennai & Bangalore. title: Support Engineer III, Chronicle
description:
**Description**
Impact
  
  
Ever wondered how Amazon offers the Earth's biggest selection and still manages to offer lower prices every day to our customers? Our retail business teams work with a massive array of vendors and business financial performance metrics to expand selection and drive costs lower. Given the rapid growth of our business, this requires our category leaders, financial analysts, site merchandisers and vendor managers to quickly analyze vendors, categories and brands, diving deep into data showing business efficiency down to the unit sale level. The technology that enables this has huge visibility and impact and is critical to Amazon's continued profitability and growth.
  
  
Innovation
  
  
We're working on the future. If you are seeking an environment where you can drive innovation. If you want to apply state-of-the-art software technologies to solve real world problems. If you want the satisfaction of providing visible benefit to end-users in an iterative fast paced environment, this is your opportunity. The responsibilities of this role will be key in paving the future of Amazon Retail and transforming how we do business.
  
  
Opportunity
  
  
You will be part of a team of creative, top-notch engineers who work hard, have fun, and make history.
  
  
As a Support Engineer, you will build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like in-house Applications and external aplications ), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for crunching and providing support for petabytes of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
Be part of a high performance, high profile team with a complete, entirely localized business charter to enhance business profitability for the Amazon Consumer business.
  
  
Platform runs entirely on AWS; high scale, engineering challenges.
  
  
Very successful team that has developed a reputation of delivering results within Amazon.
  
  
We regularly research new technologies and invest for the future of our scalability
  
  
This role is on the Chronicle team within Selling Partner Services. We own the Turismo product suite, which is powered by Ripple, a dynamic query engine. Turismo is a well loved product, with 15k+ users globally. Ripple is a PrestoDB based query engine that is built to scale, and processes 2M+ queries per week. We are a full stack team, with Product managers, UX designers, TPMs, SDEs, DEs and Data Scientists.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Provide support of incoming tickets, including extensive troubleshooting tasks, with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services
* Work on operations and maintenance driven coding projects
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments
* Develop tools to aid operations and maintenance
* System and Support status reporting
* Ownership of one or more ETL products or components
* Customer notification and workflow coordination and follow-up to maintain service level agreements
* Work with support team for handing-off or taking over active support issues and creating a team specific knowledge base and skill sets

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of software development, or 2+ years of technical support experience
* Experience scripting in modern program languages
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development
* Experience troubleshooting & maintaining hardware & software RAID
* Experience with REST web services, XML, JSON

title: Director – Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce
description:
**Director - Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to build the digital backbone that delivers next‑generation cell therapies to patients at scale?In this role, you will build and deliver the software platforms that power end‑to‑end activities related to cell therapy across development, manufacturing, and supply. Your work will directly influence how quickly and safely therapies move from treatment sites to manufacturing lines and back to patients.
  
  
You will lead a global engineering organization to compose, build, and industrialize enterprise-grade systems—spanning a Cell Orchestration platform built on Salesforce, AWS- services, and agentic AI automation. Partnering closely with operational and technology leaders, you will define a modern, scalable stack and translate strategy into robust, compliant solutions that drive speed, quality, and reliability. Based in Chennai, India, you will be at the center of a high-impact mission with global reach. How will you scale intelligent automation to orchestrate one of the most complex supply chains in healthcare?
  
  

* Accountabilities:
* Technology Planning and Architecture: Define and evolve a scalable technology strategy and reference architecture that underpins cell therapy operations from vein-to-vein, aligning platform choices with business outcomes.
* Platform Leadership: Lead the build and delivery of the Salesforce-based cellular coordination system, ensuring it is robust, scalable, secure, and fit for regulated environments.
* SDLC Ownership and DevSecOps: Own end-to-end software delivery from design to deployment and support, embedding DevSecOps, automation, and built-in quality to accelerate releases and reduce risk.
* Integration and Interoperability: Orchestrate integrations across Salesforce Service & Life Sciences -Cloud, MuleSoft, mobile-first apps, AWS services, and event streaming (e.g., Kafka) to enable seamless data and workflow continuity.
* Regulatory and Compliance Readiness: Bake compliance into every phase (GxP, HIPAA, FDA, GDPR), establishing traceability, validation, and auditability without slowing down delivery.
* Agentic AI Development or similar Automation experience is essential. Support advancing agentic AI to build autonomous software agents. They complete complex operational tasks and make decisions safely and at scale.
* Technical Roadmap: Life Sciences Cloud: Guide the industrialization of Agent-force Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and the Advanced Therapy Module to enable next-generation cell therapy delivery.
* Engineering Excellence and GenAI-Enabled SDLC: Establish best- practices for full-stack engineering and leverage GenAI for code generation, testing, and SDLC automation to boost productivity and quality.
* Talent Leadership and Culture: Build and mentor a high-performing global-team of engineers and solution architects, cultivating innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Vendor and Partner Management: Manage external partners to deliver quality, secure, and compliant solutions, optimizing for value and speed.
* Innovation and Future-Readiness: Stay ahead of LLMs, autonomous agents, and cloud-native advances; translate emerging tech into practical upgrades that modernize systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Essential Skills/Experience:
* Bachelor's - degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of software development experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role within life sciences, biotech, or manufacturing IT environments.
* Experience managing sophisticated Salesforce environments and multi-cloud implementations.
* Experience in leading multiple Product Development teams globally with engineering and delivery ownership
* Experience building and deploying software solutions in regulated environments (GxP , HIPAA, FDA).
* Expertise in modern development tools and platforms: AWS, Azure, Python, Salesforce (Service Cloud and Life Sciences), MuleSoft, Confluent / Kafka.
* Expertise delivering digital solutions across patient engagement, R&D, and product commercialization.
* Desirable Skills/Experience:
* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Platform Developer II).
* Familiarity with AI/ML features within Salesforce ecosystem (Einstein, predictive analytics).
* Understanding of GenAI use cases in software development and automated testing.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI tools and frameworks
* Solid background in system architecture, secure coding practices, and cloud-native design.
* Why AstraZeneca:

Join a purpose-led team where advanced technology meets scientific ambition to change what’s possible for patients. Here, unexpected teams—engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders—get in the same room to tackle problems that matter, with the investment and freedom to experiment through hackathons, prototypes, and scaled delivery.
