title: Senior Software Developer – Cloud Platform Engineering (OCI / Kubernetes / Java)
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Software Developer to design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud-native software solutions within Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  
  
In this IC3 individual contributor role, you will work on the Data Plane and Control Plane components of Oracle's IoT platform, combining hands-on software engineering with cloud infrastructure automation, container orchestration, and production troubleshooting.
  
  
You will collaborate with engineering, QA, and DevOps teams to improve platform reliability, optimize performance, automate deployments, and deliver high-quality software solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong Java development experience, hands-on expertise in Docker and Kubernetes, infrastructure automation capabilities, and practical experience operating software in cloud environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Cloud Platform Development: Design, develop, and enhance software components supporting the Data Plane and Control Plane of Oracle's OCI IoT platform.
* Containerization and Orchestration: Develop, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring scalability, availability, and operational stability.
* Infrastructure Automation: Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and maintenance using Terraform or Ansible to improve deployment consistency and operational efficiency.
* Software Engineering and API Development: Develop and optimize Java-based software components and APIs, applying software design principles, concurrency concepts, secure coding practices, and appropriate testing strategies.
* Production Reliability and Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve application, infrastructure, networking, and integration issues while improving observability, system performance, and service availability.
* Security and Operational Excellence: Implement cloud security best practices, support vulnerability remediation, and contribute to maintenance, patching, monitoring, and reliability improvements.
* Cross-Functional Engineering Collaboration: Partner with development, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders to deliver software enhancements, conduct code reviews, resolve defects, and improve engineering standards.
* Technical Ownership and Continuous Improvement: Independently manage assigned engineering deliverables, contribute to architecture-aligned design decisions, mentor colleagues where appropriate, and identify opportunities to improve development and operational processes.

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**
**AreaEssential Requirements**
Education BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
  
Experience 5+ years of software industry experience, including 3+ years in a senior developer or technical leadership capacity.
  
  
Programming Experience in Java and Python, including Java software design principles, concurrency, debugging, and development best practices.
  
  
Containers Strong hands-on expertise with Docker and Kubernetes, including deployment and troubleshooting.
  
  
Infrastructure as Code Practical experience automating infrastructure using Terraform or Ansible.
  
  
Cloud platforms Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: OCI, AWS, or Azure.
  
  
Software engineering Ability to design, develop, test, troubleshoot, and optimize scalable software components and APIs.
  
  
Production troubleshooting Ability to diagnose and resolve software and infrastructure issues in production environments.
  
  
Cloud networking Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including cloud configuration and troubleshooting.
  
  
Cloud security Knowledge of cloud security and secure software development practices.
  
  
Collaboration Ability to work independently, collaborate across engineering teams, communicate effectively, and adapt to new technologies.
  
  
**Good-to-Have**

* Prior experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
* Experience developing and deploying CI/CD pipelines across multi-cluster, multi-region, or multi-architecture environments.
* Experience in the Internet of Things (IoT) domain.
* Exposure to cloud-native platform engineering involving Data Plane and Control Plane components.

Important classification note: The original JD explicitly lists IoT experience and complex CI/CD environments as preferred. OCI-specific experience is not mandatory because AWS or Azure experience is also accepted. Data Plane/Control Plane experience is treated as an advantage rather than a screening requirement because the JD describes it as work to be performed, not an explicit prior-experience prerequisite.

* Have I worked hands-on with Java and Python, including developing, debugging, and optimizing software components?
* Am I confident deploying and troubleshooting Docker-based applications in Kubernetes environments?
* Have I automated infrastructure using Terraform or Ansible and worked with OCI, AWS, or Azure?
* Can I independently investigate production issues involving applications, APIs, networking, security, or cloud infrastructure and collaborate effectively to resolve them?

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Your role**
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Senior Software Engineer**
**What We Need**
Corpay is currently looking to hire a Senior Software Engineer within our Alpha division.
  
  
In this role, you will play a key part in designing, developing, and evolving the cloud-native applications, backend services, and event-driven systems that underpin Corpay's eMoney and FX platforms. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will build secure, resilient, and scalable software solutions that support business-critical financial services.
  
  
This team focuses on delivering software that improves operational efficiency, enables business capabilities, and provides reusable technical solutions across the organisation. You'll build applications and services that automate business processes, connect systems through event-driven architectures, and enable engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable solutions. The systems you develop will play a critical role in enabling and supporting the platforms, workflows, and services that power Corpay's global payments ecosystem.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will contribute to architectural decisions, take ownership of complex technical initiatives, mentor other engineers, and champion engineering best practices while remaining hands-on throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
At Corpay, we value engineers who are curious, collaborative, and pragmatic problem solvers. We encourage ownership, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing, giving our engineers the opportunity to influence technical decisions while building reliable, scalable software that supports our wider engineering organisation.
  
  
**How We Work**
As a Senior Software Engineer, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
  
  

* A collaborative and supportive engineering environment based in our Chennai office
* Company-issued equipment
* Formal, hands-on training and onboarding
* Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development
* Exposure to modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices
* Opportunities to collaborate with globally distributed engineering, product, and architecture teams

**Role Responsibilities**
The responsibilities of the role will include:
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available cloud-native applications and backend services that support Corpay's eMoney and FX ecosystem.
* Design and implement event-driven applications and distributed systems using asynchronous messaging patterns to enable scalable communication and integration between business systems.
* Design and develop software solutions using C# and .NET, leveraging AWS, serverless technologies, and modern architectural patterns.
* Develop reusable backend services, RESTful APIs, and shared application capabilities that can be leveraged across multiple products and engineering teams.
* Design and build software that automates business processes, improves operational efficiency, and enables scalable integration across business platforms.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, and engineering teams to analyse business requirements and deliver high-quality technical solutions.
* Contribute to the design and evolution of distributed systems, providing input into architecture, scalability, resilience, security, and performance.
* Take ownership of technical delivery throughout the software development lifecycle, from solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code while promoting engineering best practices, secure development principles, and coding standards.
* Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and helping maintain high engineering standards across the team.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and day-to-day collaboration.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term improvements to system reliability and application performance.
* Work closely with DevOps and Infrastructure teams to ensure applications are scalable, observable, and operationally resilient.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, API documentation, and architectural decisions.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve software quality, operational efficiency, engineering processes, and system performance.
* Communicate technical solutions and progress effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum of 8 years of professional software engineering experience designing and building scalable backend systems and cloud-native applications.
* Strong experience developing applications using C# and modern .NET.
* Strong experience designing cloud-native applications using AWS and serverless architectures.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture.
* Strong experience designing and developing event-driven applications using messaging and event streaming technologies such as Amazon EventBridge, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS/SNS, or similar.
* Experience designing and developing reusable backend services, RESTful APIs, and system integrations.
* Experience building workflow automation, business process orchestration, or event-driven business applications.
* Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modelling and performance optimisation.
* Experience defining and maintaining cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, with practical experience of AWS CloudFormation.
* Good understanding of Kubernetes and modern cloud deployment environments.
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability practices for production systems.
* Strong understanding of secure software development principles and cloud security best practices.
* Experience designing highly available, resilient, business-critical software systems.
* Ability to analyse complex business processes and design scalable software solutions that automate workflows and improve operational efficiency.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience within financial services, payments, banking, or other regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Clean Architecture, and modern software architecture patterns.
* Experience working with distributed caching technologies such as Redis.
* Experience contributing to CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Earned leave, sick leave, casual leave, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave.
* Group medical insurance for employees and eligible dependents.
* Personal accident insurance.
* Wellness allowance and annual health check-ups for employees and their families.
* Broadband reimbursement and meal card support.
* Commuting allowance.
* Provident Fund, Voluntary Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Pension benefits.
* Opportunities to participate in philanthropic initiatives.
* Inclusive workplace culture with employee engagement activities and company events.

**About Corpay**
**About Corpay**
Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.
  
  
At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.
  
  
As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre-employment screening conducted by an authorized third-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.
  
  
**Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:**
Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions.
  
  
Learn more about Corpay: https://www.corpay.com
  
  
**Transparency & Compliance**
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. If you require reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please notify a representative of the Human Resources Department.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring**
Corpay may use artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening, candidate assessment, or interview scheduling. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes.
  
  
**Candidate Privacy Notice**
For information about how Corpay processes personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice: https://www.corpay.com/privacy-policy.
  
  
**Pay Philosophy**
Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. Compensation decisions are based on objective, job-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Where required by applicable law, salary or compensation ranges will be included in the job posting or provided prior to the interview process, where required by applicable law. Additional compensation elements such as bonuses, incentives, benefits, or variable pay may apply where applicable.

**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.

**#ZEOLife at Zuora**
As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it’s exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as “ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we’re making what’s next possible for our customers, community and the world.
  
  
As Part Of Our Commitment To Building An Inclusive, High-performance Culture Where ZEOs Feel Inspired, Connected And Valued, We Support ZEOs With
  
  
Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs
  
  
Medical, dental and vision insurance
  
  
Generous, flexible time off
  
  
Paid holidays, “wellness” days and company wide end of year break
  
  
Learning & Development stipend
  
  
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match
  
  
Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing
  
  

* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.

Location & Work Arrangements
  
  
Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.
  
  
Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.
  
  
Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

title: Product Security Architect IRC286354
description:
**Description**
Looking for a Product Security Architect to lead our offensive and defensive security strategies. You will be embedded with engineering teams to ensure our products are resilient against sophisticated attacks. This is a “hands-on” role: you will write security-centric code, conduct deep-dive penetration tests, and automate threat detection within our pipelines. You are not just an auditor; you are a builder who solves security challenges with engineering solutions.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Technical Mastery Required**
Security Frameworks: OWASP ASVS, SAMM, NIST 800-53, and Cloud Security Alliance (CSA).
  
  
Offensive Tools: Burp Suite Professional, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Nmap, and Postman (for API hacking).
  
  
Secure Coding: Deep knowledge of vulnerabilities in Java/.NET and how to prevent them (e.g., SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF).
  
  
Cloud Security: Securing Kubernetes (K8s) secrets, IAM Least Privilege, and Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP).
  
  
Identity/Auth: Expert-level understanding of JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and WebAuthn/FIDO2.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Experience: 10+ years in Cybersecurity or Software Engineering, with 4+ years specifically in Product Security or Application Security (AppSec).
  
  
Mindset: A “Breaker” mentality balanced with a “Builder’s” empathy; the ability to explain why a vulnerability matters to a product owner.
  
  
Certifications: OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
  
  
Communication: Ability to translate complex exploitation paths into clear risk assessments for non-technical leadership.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Secure Architecture & Threat Modeling

Threat Modeling: Lead structured threat modeling sessions (using STRIDE or PASTA) during the design phase to identify architectural flaws before a single line of code is written.
  
  
Architecture Reviews: Conduct deep-dive security reviews of system designs, focusing on authentication (OIDC/SAML), authorization (RBAC/ABAC), and data isolation.
  
  
Security Scaffolding: Build and maintain shared security libraries (e.g., standardized encryption wrappers, input validation modules) for use by all engineering teams.
  
  
  

* Offensive Security & Exploitation

In-House Pentesting: Perform regular manual penetration tests on web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure to identify logic flaws that automated tools miss.
  
  
Exploitation Research: Develop PoC (Proof of Concept) exploits for discovered vulnerabilities to demonstrate impact to stakeholders and validate remediation.
  
  
Bug Bounty Management: Oversee the bug bounty program, triaging reports and working directly with developers on high-severity fixes.
  
  
  

* Secure Coding & SDLC Integration

Secure Code Review: Review high-risk pull requests (e.g., changes to auth, payments, or crypto) to ensure compliance with OWASP Top 10 and ASVS.
  
  
Automation (DevSecOps): Integrate and fine-tune SAST, DAST, and SCA tools into the CI/CD pipeline to reduce “false positive” fatigue for developers.
  
  
Vulnerability Remediation: Don’t just find bugs—write the code to fix them. Pair-program with engineers to implement secure patterns.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Lead Engineer - Controls & Protection
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
  
  
Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung.Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird.Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**

* Identifizieren, entwickeln, bewerten, führen ein und verwalten Engineering-Lösungen für die Anforderungen der Produkt- und Steuerungssystemtechnologie. Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen.
* Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen.Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind.Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann.Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder

**Grundqualifikationen**

* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).

**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**

* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

title: Lead Specialist, Enterprise Architect - (AI Systems & Distributed Engineering)
description:
**Job Title: Advance Specialist ,Enterprise Architect**

  
  

**About the role:**

  
  

Seeking a visionary Enterprise Architect to be part of the Enterprise Architecture team. This is not an "advisory" role — we require a practitioner who balances high-level strategic governance with deep-dive technical execution. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between traditional distributed and enterprise systems and the emerging frontier of Agentic AI, transforming how the enterprise leverages autonomous agents and LLM-driven workflows.

  
  

**Experience Level:**
12-15 Years
**Location:**
Bangalore or Chennai, India
**Role Type:**
Hands-on Enterprise Architect

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  
* **Architectural Strategy & Blueprint Ownership**
  
  
* Own and maintain the enterprise architecture blueprint — current-state and target-state views across application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers.
  
  
* Define and evangelize reference architectures and reusable patterns for agentic AI systems (agent orchestration, tool-calling, memory/state management, guardrails) so delivery teams don't reinvent foundational patterns per project.
  
  
* **AI Agent Ecosystems**
  
  
* Design and govern the architecture for multi-agent systems, including agent-to-agent communication protocols, orchestration frameworks, and tool/function-calling interfaces.
  
  
* Define standards for grounding, memory, retrieval, and context management across LLM-driven workflows.
  
  
* Establish human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths for autonomous agents operating on production data or systems.
  
  
* Evaluate and select frameworks/platforms for agent orchestration (e.g., orchestration engines, model routing, guardrail layers), balancing build vs. buy.
  
  
* **Modeling & Governance**
  
  
* Chair or actively participate in the Architecture Review Chapter; define review cadence, entry/exit criteria, and a clear exception-handling process for teams that need to move fast.
  
  
* Own Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and maintain a lightweight, non-bureaucratic approval workflow so governance catches drift without blocking delivery.
  
  
* Define non-negotiable guardrails for AI/agentic systems — data access boundaries, PII handling, human-in-the-loop requirements, and audit logging — that any new agent workflow must pass through review.
  
  
* Maintain enterprise modeling artifacts (capability maps, data flow diagrams, integration catalogs) as the single source of truth referenced during reviews.
  

  

**Required Technical Skills**

  
  

**AI**

  

  
* Hands-on experience with LLM application architecture: RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, prompt/context engineering, model evaluation and guardrails.
  
  
* Familiarity with multi-agent orchestration patterns and tool-use/function-calling architectures.
  

  

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

  

  
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP), containerization (Kubernetes), and infra-as-code.
  
  
* Experience designing for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency at enterprise scale.
  

  

**Distributed & Enterprise Systems Integration**

  

  
* Strong background in distributed systems design (event-driven architecture, microservices, API gateways, messaging systems).
  
  
* Experience integrating legacy enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, core platforms) with modern cloud-native and AI-driven components.
  

  

**Data Architecture**

  

  
* Experience designing enterprise data architectures — data pipelines, data mesh/data fabric concepts, governance, and lineage.
  
  
* Ability to model and maintain the data-flow view that underpins the enterprise digital twin.
  

  

**Modeling & Governance Tooling**

  

  
* Practical experience with architecture modeling notations/tools (e.g., ArchiMate, C4 model, TOGAF-aligned frameworks) and running formal EA review processes.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  

  
* 12 - 15 years of progressive experience in software engineering and solution architecture.
  
  
* Demonstrated ability to strategise and develop PoC and add create practices around it.
  
  
* A portfolio of successful large-scale modernization or AI-transformation projects, ideally including experience participating in an EA governance process (ARB, ADRs) from scratch or maturing an existing one.
  
  
* Prior experience building or working with an enterprise digital twin or equivalent simulation/dependency-modeling capability is a strong plus.
  

  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

description:

The Systems Engineering family is responsible for the entire technical effort to evolve and verify solutions that satisfy client needs. The primary focus is centered on reducing risk and improving the efficiency, performance, stability, security, and quality of all systems and platforms. * Align risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalate appropriately.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in mainframe systems engineering, system programming, or operations

description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
  
  
Beeinflusst die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit und der Arbeit anderer im Team.Führt betriebliche/technische Standardaufgaben aus, die in der Regel Anweisungen und Arbeitsabläufen unterliegen.Möglicherweise besteht Spielraum, um die Reihenfolge zu ändern und Aufgaben/Pflichten basierend auf sich ändernden Arbeitssituationen zu erledigen.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**

* Führt Komponenten- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem.
* Erweiterung der Kenntnisse der eigenen technischen Disziplin zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.Kann Support-Rollen mit spezialisiertem technischem Wissensgebiet beinhalten; laufender Erwerb von Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten auf höherem Niveau.
* Grundlegendes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Gute Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Kann eine gewisse Autonomie besitzen, um Entscheidungen innerhalb eines definierten Rahmens zu treffen.Löst Probleme in Situationen, in denen gute technische Kenntnisse und Urteilsvermögen im Rahmen festgelegter Verfahren erforderlich sind.Konsultiert hochrangigere Teammitglieder zu Problemen außerhalb definierter Anweisungen/Parameter.
* Eine Stelle auf diesem Niveau erfordert gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und kann notwendig sein, um ein Junior-Team zu führen.Entwickelt für kundenorientierte Rollen starke Kundenbeziehungen und dient als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und GE Vernova.Erklärt anderen technische Informationen.

**Grundqualifikationen**

* Diese Rolle erfordert grundlegende Erfahrung . Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit entsprechender Erfahrung).

**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**

* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten. Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

Yes

title: Senior Software Engineer - Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE)

**Role: Senior Software Engineer -**
**Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE)**
**Location: Bengaluru/Chennai - Hybrid (3 days in Office per week)**

  
  

**About Pearson**

  
  

Pearson is the world’s leading learning company, dedicated to helping people make progress in their lives through education. We deliver high-quality content, assessments, and digital services to learners, educators, and institutions globally. Our mission is to empower every learner to achieve their potential.

  
  

**Role Summary**

  
  

We are seeking a
**Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE)**
who combines strong software engineering expertise with a customer-centric mindset to solve complex business problems and deliver production-ready solutions.

  
  

The FDE works closely with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and engineers to understand customer needs, validate ideas, build proof-of-concepts, and deliver scalable capabilities using modern engineering practices.

  
  

This role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on engineering expertise, and the ability to translate business requirements into secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

  
  

Success is measured by delivering customer value, accelerating solution delivery, and enabling successful adoption of the capabilities delivered.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Customer-Centric Solution Delivery**

  

  
* Work directly with customers, business stakeholders, and product teams to understand requirements and desired outcomes.
  
  
* Analyse customer journeys, business workflows, and user pain points.
  
  
* Translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
  
  
* Ensure customer value remains at the centre of the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Gather feedback and continuously improve delivered solutions.
  

  

**Solution Discovery & Proof of Concepts**

  

  
* Lead technical discovery sessions and solution design workshops.
  
  
* Develop proof-of-concepts (POCs), prototypes, and minimum viable solutions to validate assumptions, demonstrate value, and reduce implementation risk.
  
  
* Evaluate technology options and recommend suitable approaches.
  
  
* Present technical recommendations and trade-offs to stakeholders.
  
  
* Support solution shaping and implementation planning activities.
  

  

**Software Engineering**

  

  
* Design, develop, test, and deploy production-grade software solutions.
  
  
* Build APIs, integrations, microservices, automations, and cloud-native applications.
  
  
* Participate in architecture and design discussions.
  
  
* Apply software engineering best practices, coding standards, and testing approaches.
  
  
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical problems.
  

  

**Cloud Engineering**

  

  
* Design, build, and support solutions on AWS and/or Azure.
  
  
* Apply Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Kubernetes, cloud automation, and deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and operational controls.
  
  
* Design and contribute to scalable, resilient, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions.
  
  
* Follow cloud engineering and operational excellence practices.
  

  

**Secure-by-Design Engineering**

  

  
* Apply secure-by-design principles throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
* Implement secure coding practices and security controls.
  
  
* Participate in threat modelling, vulnerability remediation, and security reviews.
  
  
* Apply DevSecOps practices, including automated security validation and compliance checks.
  
  
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise security and governance standards.
  

  

**AI-Assisted Engineering**

  

  
* Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity and software quality.
  
  
* Apply AI-supported approaches for coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and automation.
  
  
* Contribute to agentic and automation initiatives where appropriate.
  
  
* Follow responsible AI and data governance practices.
  

  

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

  

  
* Provide technical leadership within project teams.
  
  
* Mentor engineers and contribute to technical knowledge sharing.
  
  
* Lead code reviews, design reviews, and engineering discussions.
  
  
* Collaborate with architects, security teams, product teams, and cloud engineers.
  
  
* Influence technical decisions through technical expertise, collaboration, and data-driven recommendations.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

**Customer Focus & Business Acumen**

  

  
* Strong customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering measurable business value.
  
  
* Experience engaging directly with customers, business stakeholders, and product teams to understand problems, validate assumptions, and shape technical solutions.
  
  
* Ability to balance customer experience, business priorities, technical constraints, security requirements, and operational considerations.
  

  

**Software Engineering**

  

  
* Strong software development experience using Python, Java, TypeScript, or similar technologies.
  
  
* Experience building APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
  
  
* Understanding of microservices architecture and modern software engineering principles.
  
  
* Experience delivering production-grade solutions.
  

  

**Cloud Engineering**

  

  
* Experience with AWS and/or Azure.
  
  
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Kubernetes, cloud automation, and deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Knowledge of observability, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence practices.
  
  
* Understanding of cloud security, scalability, resilience, and cost optimisation.
  

  

**Security**

  

  
* Experience applying secure software development practices.
  
  
* Understanding of authentication, authorisation, data protection, encryption, and application security.
  
  
* Familiarity with DevSecOps principles and security automation.
  

  

**AI-Assisted Engineering**

  

  
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools within development workflows.
  
  
* Understanding of automation, agentic engineering concepts, and modern AI-assisted delivery practices.
  
  
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices and governance considerations.
  

  

**Leadership & Communication**

  

  
* Demonstrated technical leadership within engineering teams.
  
  
* Experience leading proof-of-concepts, pilots, or complex technical initiatives.
  
  
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  
  
* Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  
  
* Passion for continuous learning and innovation.
  

  

**Success Measures**

  
  

**Success in this role is demonstrated through:**

  

  
* Successful delivery of secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.
  
  
* Effective execution of proof-of-concepts and technology validations.
  
  
* Positive customer, stakeholder, and business outcomes.
  
  
* High-quality engineering practices and code quality.
  
  
* Adoption of cloud engineering, automation, security, and AI-assisted development practices.
  
  
* Strong technical leadership and collaboration within teams.
  
  
* Contribution to reusable engineering patterns and continuous improvement.
  

  

**What This Role Is Not**

  

  
* Not a pure Enterprise Architect.
  
  
* Not a traditional Software Engineer working only from a predefined backlog.
  
  
* Not a Consultant providing recommendations without accountability.
  
  
* Not a Project Manager.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**Description**
Amazon.com is looking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Software Development Engineer to join the Digital Content Platform team. The Digital Acceleration Commerce team owns services supporting the publishing, pricing and purchase of Digital content, including Kindle Books, Amazon AppStore, Amazon Music, Amazon Video, etc.
  
  
This candidate will be joining a team working on scalable web services using cloud technologies. The work will be highly visible to Amazon customers and internal stakeholders.
  
  
As a Senior Software Development Engineer, this person will lead the architecture and development of high-scale web services and workflows. A successful candidate will have an established background in designing and developing back-end web services, strong technical skills, a motivation to achieve results in a fast-paced environment, high creativity, and great analytical reasoning skills.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer III (SDE3) on the Digital Pricing and Promotions team, you will design and build software solutions that power promotional capabilities across Amazon's Digital Acceleration (DA) businesses — including Kindle, Prime Video, and Music. You will own and evolve critical platforms that deliver promotional management, competitive pricing intelligence, and operational automation to pricing managers, business teams, and product managers across DA.
  
  
You will take meaningful ownership of key products — particularly the Promos UI platform — driving features from initial design through deployment and ongoing maintenance. Your work will span full-stack development: crafting user interfaces with modern web technologies, building robust backend services in Java on AWS, and integrating with Retail promotion systems such as PLM (Promotion Lifecycle Management).
  
  
In this role, you will make architectural decisions that balance near-term business needs with long-term scalability and maintainability. You will think across systems — considering performance at scale, multi-business extensibility, and integration with diverse data sources and downstream services. You will lead technical designs independently, engage actively in design reviews, and provide substantive code review feedback that raises the bar for the team.
  
  
Collaboration is central to this role. You will work closely with operations teams, business stakeholders, Retail promotion platform teams, and partner engineering organizations. You will develop a deep understanding of customer workflows and pain points, translating them into well-designed, reliable solutions. You will champion operational excellence through proactive monitoring, incident response, and identifying opportunities for automation and process improvement.
  
  
Beyond individual delivery, you will help grow the team — mentoring junior engineers, contributing to development best practices, and driving technical improvements that increase the team's overall velocity and reliability. Success in this role means consistently shipping high-quality features that advance our promotional capabilities while setting a strong example for engineering craft and customer focus.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 7+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:

AssetPlus is redefining wealth management in India. We build a high-performance SaaS fintech platform that empowers mutual fund distributors (MFDs) and financial advisors with modern tools to streamline investment management. Our mission is to construct India’s premier assisted wealth management platform, helping millions of households achieve their long-term financial goals.

**ENGINEERING @ ASSETPLUS**

Our engineering team is a high-velocity, growth-focused group of ~18 engineers structured across three core product pods in Chennai. We operate on a modern, AI-enabled Node.js + TypeScript + MongoDB stack, end-to-end owning our services in production with high autonomy while maintaining rigorous technical and cultural standards. You bring strong technical judgment, speed, clarity, and architectural simplicity to your work. As a core builder reporting to a Staff Engineer in a product pod, you will design services, write production-grade Node.js + TypeScript code, architect MongoDB schemas, debug across backend, React, and Flutter apps, and ensure high system reliability. You will also leverage AI-driven development as a core cognitive partner to accelerate delivery while upholding exceptional quality.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Architecture & Systems*

* Design and build scalable, resilient microservices and features with high autonomy within your pod's domain.
* Lead system design reviews, articulating technical trade-offs with first-principles reasoning.
* Evaluate and decide whether to build, reuse, or integrate open-source solutions, justifying architecture choices.
* Establish, follow, and strengthen team-wide modern architectural patterns and best practices.

*Hands-On Engineering*

* Write clean, highly maintainable, and testable Node.js + TypeScript code for production systems.
* Architect efficient MongoDB schemas and build optimized aggregations for high-throughput queries.
* Debug full-stack issues across React, Flutter, and backend services down to database and infrastructure layers.
* Utilize modern AI developer tools to ship features rapidly with end-to-end ownership without compromising code quality.

*AI-Driven Engineering*

* Leverage AI tools as a cognitive partner to accelerate code generation, debugging, system design, and execution.
* Integrate AI models, context, and workflows into daily development loops for maximum efficiency.
* Continuously explore and adopt emerging AI capabilities to improve engineering output and code reliability.
* Promote AI-native engineering practices and workflows across your product pod.

*Reliability & Support*

* Monitor system health proactively and identify potential issues before impact.
* Respond swiftly to critical incidents, ensuring minimal downtime and high uptime.
* Lead root-cause analyses (RCAs), optimize system performance, and enhance observability.

*Developer Experience & Quality*

* Enhance internal developer tooling, automation, and CI/CD workflows.
* Uphold rigorous engineering standards around code clarity, testing, security, and simplicity.
* Champion lightweight, modular, and maintainable engineering design principles.

*Leadership & Collaboration*

* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, providing constructive code reviews and technical guidance.
* Communicate technical architecture and product decisions clearly across stakeholders.
* Foster an open, collaborative, and fast-paced engineering culture.

**WHAT WE LOOK FOR**

*Requirements:*

* 6–8 years of full-stack engineering experience with a strong backend focus (tenure is indicative; we value ownership and capability).
* Proven track record with Node.js and TypeScript in production, having owned services end-to-end.
* Deep expertise in MongoDB schema design, indexing, and complex aggregations.
* Experience operating high-load production systems with full accountability for uptime and performance.
* Strong full-stack debugging skills spanning backend services, frontends, and database layers.
* Pragmatic technical judgment with a bias for simple, maintainable solutions over complex ones.
* Excellent communication skills to articulate technical ideas and system decisions clearly.

* Active use of AI tools to significantly boost engineering velocity.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers and conducting high-quality code reviews.
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and GitHub-based development workflows.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Business / Organization Overview
  
  
We are looking for a high-caliber
**Senior Java Technical Lead / Architect (C13)**
to spearhead the architecture, engineering strategy, and technical delivery of enterprise-scale distributed platforms. In this strategic technical leadership position, you will govern large-scale engineering initiatives, drive cloud-native modernization, set foundational architecture patterns, and mentor multiple agile engineering squads across globally distributed teams.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
At the
**C13 grade**
, you will operate as a subject matter expert and technical authority combining deep architectural mastery with strategic delivery oversight. You will lead end-to-end design, technology evaluation, security governance, and multi-system integration across distributed microservices, high-throughput event streaming, enterprise databases, and container platforms. You will partner with Directors, Enterprise Architects, Product Managers, and Business Leaders to ensure technology roadmaps align with business transformation objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Architecture & System Design
  
  

* Own end-to-end technical architecture, system decomposition, and integration strategy for complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.
* Define architectural blueprints, domain models, and technical design standards for high-throughput, low-latency, and highly available microservices.
* Lead technology evaluation, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and modernization roadmaps (e.g., legacy monolith/WebSphere decomposition to cloud-native microservices and event-driven architectures).
* Formally represent the application in Enterprise Architecture Governance, Security Reviews, and Technology Risk committees.

Technical Governance & Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Provide technical leadership and architectural oversight across multiple development teams and technical leads (C11/C12).
* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, Clean Code practices, comprehensive automated testing (TDD/BDD), and robust CI/CD DevOps pipelines.
* Establish standards for non-functional requirements (NFRs) including system resilience, fault tolerance, high availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), low latency, and horizontal scalability.
* Drive modernization of messaging pipelines, event stream topologies, and polyglot persistence layers.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Executive Stakeholders to translate multi-year business strategies into actionable, phased technical roadmaps.
* Manage architectural risks, technical debt remediation, and capacity planning.
* Act as the senior escalation authority for critical production incidents, driving root cause analysis (RCA) and long-term architectural stability solutions.

Mentorship & Talent Development
  
  

* Foster an inclusive, high-performance engineering culture emphasizing continuous learning, innovation, and technical rigor.
* Mentor and develop senior engineers and technical leads, building leadership pipelines and engineering talent across the organization.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Competencies**
Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 15+ years of overall software engineering experience in enterprise-grade applications, with at least 5+ years in a senior technical lead, software architect or engineering leadership capacity.
* Proven track record of architecting, delivering, and supporting high-throughput, mission-critical systems in financial services, banking, or large enterprise domains.

**Primary Skills & Technical Mastery**

* Core Java & Advanced JVM Engineering: Deep mastery of Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), high-concurrency programming, multithreading, memory management, garbage collection tuning (ZGC/G1), and low-latency optimization.
* Spring Ecosystem & Microservices Architecture: Extensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch) and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
* Event-Driven Architecture & Distributed Messaging:
* Expert-level design and production operations with Apache Kafka (cluster architecture, partitions, consumer groups, Kafka Streams/Connect, schema registry, idempotent producers).
* Enterprise messaging and integration via IBM MQ / JMS and transaction management across distributed systems (Saga pattern, two-phase commit alternatives).
* API Strategy & Integration Patterns: Advanced RESTful API design, OpenAPI standards, API Gateways, gRPC, OAuth2/OIDC, and mutual TLS (mTLS).
* Polyglot Database Architecture:
* Relational: Oracle (advanced PL/SQL, partitioning, index optimization, query execution plan analysis, Active Data Guard).
* NoSQL / Document: MongoDB (sharding, replica sets, aggregation pipelines, performance tuning at scale).
* Resilience & Fault Tolerance Patterns: Proven experience implementing Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j), Rate Limiting, Bulkheads, and Distributed Tracing (OpenTelemetry/Jaeger).

Secondary Skills & Modernization Competencies
  
  

* Containerization & Cloud Native Platforms: Architectural expertise in container platforms, specifically Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes and AWS ECS, including Pod autoscaling, ingress controllers, and Helm chart lifecycle management.
* Legacy Modernization & Middleware: Experience migrating workloads from legacy application servers (IBM WebSphere WAS/ND) and workflow orchestrators (IBM BAW / BPM) to modern microservices and cloud runtimes.
* Frontend Architecture Exposure: Solid understanding of modern SPA architecture, frontend integration, and frameworks like Angular (TypeScript, state management).
* DevOps & Automation: In-depth knowledge of modern CI/CD automation (Harness, Tekton, Jenkins), infrastructure-as-code, and automated security scanning tools (SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk, Prisma).

Leadership & Executive Competencies
  
  

* Strategic Vision: Ability to conceptualize multi-year technical strategies and execute them incrementally within agile frameworks.
* Executive Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing both technical teams and senior executive leadership.
* Problem Solving & Decision Making: Strong analytical acumen with proven ability to make pragmatic architectural trade-offs under constraints.
* Delivery Ownership: High accountability for end-to-end software delivery, operational excellence, and production resilience.

title: Wifi Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Wi-Fi Software Engineer to lead the development of wireless connectivity solutions for In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) systems. The role involves designing, developing, and optimizing Wi-Fi features across Android and Linux platforms, ensuring robust performance, seamless connectivity, and compliance with industry standards.Key Responsibilities  Design and develop Wi-Fi software modules for IVI systems on Android (AOSP) and Linux platforms.  Implement and enhance Wi-Fi features including Access Point (AP), Station (STA), and Wi-Fi Direct (P2P).  Work on end-to-end feature development across the Wi-Fi stack, including driver, framework, and application layers.  Perform root cause analysis, debugging, and issue resolution across development, integration, and maintenance phases.  Analyze Wi-Fi sniffer logs and pcap traces to troubleshoot complex connectivity and performance issues.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams including BSP, hardware, and system integration teams.  Ensure compliance with Wi-Fi Alliance certification requirements.  Contribute to system stability, performance tuning, and continuous improvement initiatives. 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)  Strong expertise in Wi-Fi features within IVI systems.  Proficiency in C, C++, and/or Java programming.  Hands-on experience with Android AOSP and Linux-based infotainment environments.  In-depth knowledge of Wi-Fi standards: 802.11n, 802.11ac, 802.11ax.  Strong understanding of Wi-Fi security protocols: WPA2, WPA3.  Solid understanding of Android and Linux networking stack.  Expertise in Wi-Fi packet capture, sniffer tools, and pcap analysis.  Experience in executing and supporting Wi-Fi Alliance certification.

title: NICE CXOne Developer

By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. * Review support tickets with agency leadership and oversee any support questions from other team members that might be working on one of those agencies’ tickets

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience with Nice InContact CXone.
* 5+ years of professional background with NICE CXOne Studio scripting experience.
* Hands-on experience with NICE InContact and/or NICE CXone solutions.
* Experience with cloud-based SaaS/PaaS/IaaS providers and working with virtualized systems, including application servers, databases, and networking infrastructure.
* Understand business requirements with the ability to translate into technical requirements.
* Conflict management and clear organizational communication.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in Contact Center Dashboard Creation.
* Base knowledge of intersystem networking, and data traffic flow between components.
* Ability to troubleshoot end-to-end Call center applications including Chrome and Edge issues when interacting with a Web-based application like Salesforce/ Microsoft Dynamics

**Additional Information**

* Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
* Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
* Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
* Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
* Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
* Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
* Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

title: Zoho Developer — Internal Business Systems
description:
**About The Role**
S&J Group is a supply chain business with operations across aviation, freight forwarding, courier services and trading. We use Zoho extensively to manage our operations, finance, sales and people processes.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Zoho Developer to build, integrate and improve our internal business platforms. This is an in-house role, working exclusively on S&J Group’s systems. You will work closely with our teams to understand their needs, identify opportunities for improvement and develop solutions that make everyday work faster, more reliable and easier to manage.
  
  
We want someone who takes ownership, questions inefficient processes and contributes ideas alongside technical expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure and customise Zoho CRM, including modules, fields, layouts, Blueprints, workflows, validation rules and access permissions.
* Develop, test and maintain Deluge scripts, custom functions and business process automations.
* Build and maintain integrations across Zoho applications, including CRM, Books, People, Payroll, Projects and Analytics.
* Connect Zoho with internal platforms and external services using REST APIs, OAuth and webhooks.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions, explaining options and trade-offs clearly.
* Improve data quality, application reliability and the flow of information between departments and systems.
* Support data migration, field mapping, deduplication and reconciliation.
* Troubleshoot application issues, failed automations and integration errors, addressing their underlying causes.
* Test changes before rollout and maintain clear technical documentation, configuration records and user guidance.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, external development teams and Zoho support when required.
* Help users adopt new features and improve how they use existing systems.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Proven hands-on experience developing and customising solutions within the Zoho ecosystem.
* Strong proficiency in Deluge scripting and Zoho CRM.
* Experience with workflows, Blueprints, custom functions, approval processes and role-based access.
* Practical knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, OAuth authentication and webhooks.
* Experience integrating Zoho applications and handling synchronisation errors and duplicate records.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand business processes and recommend solutions beyond the initial request.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
* A disciplined approach to testing, documentation, data security and ongoing maintenance.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with Zoho Books, People, Payroll, Projects, Analytics, Creator or Flow.
* Experience migrating from Bigin to Zoho CRM or implementing CRM–Books integrations.
* Familiarity with SQL, reporting and dashboards.
* Working knowledge of PHP/Laravel or JavaScript.
* Exposure to logistics, supply chain, finance or other operations-intensive businesses.
* Experience managing systems across multiple business entities.

**What Success Looks Like**
Your solutions reduce manual work, keep information accurate across systems and give teams better visibility into their operations. You understand why a process exists, identify what needs to improve and take responsibility for delivering a solution that works reliably in daily use.
  
  
**Why Join S&J Group?**

* Own and improve business systems used across multiple divisions.
* Work directly with business users and decision-makers.
* See the practical impact of your work on daily operations.
* Contribute ideas and help shape our technology roadmap.
* Build long-term expertise in a business deeply invested in the Zoho ecosystem.

**How To Apply**
Submit your CV along with a brief description of one or two Zoho solutions you have built. Explain the business problem, the applications involved, your contribution and the outcome.

title: Lead Software Engineer, Data Engineering
description:

Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https://www.valgenesis.com/about

We’re in it to win it. We’re on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won’t settle for anything less than being a market leader.
