Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company.

title: Senior Software Engineer II
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Financial Crime and Risk Management (FCRM) team within Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) at American Express is building the next generation of AI-enabled, world-class capabilities to support second-line risk and compliance functions and financial crime investigation teams.
  
  
We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Actimize Engineer to help design, develop, enhance, and scale our NICE Actimize Suspicious Activity Monitoring (SAM) platform supporting Anti-Money Laundering (AML) transaction monitoring and regulatory compliance initiatives across the company.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise in Actimize SAM, strong software and data engineering skills, and experience delivering scalable, reliable, and high-performance AML transaction monitoring solutions. This role will play a critical part in modernizing our AML technology ecosystem, enhancing transaction monitoring capabilities, and supporting enterprise-wide platform reliability and AI readiness initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, configure, customize, test, deploy, and support NICE Actimize SAM solutions to meet AML transaction monitoring and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Develop, enhance, and maintain Actimize SAM detection scenarios, monitoring rules, thresholds, and configurations to support evolving AML business and regulatory requirements.
* Work extensively with Actimize SAM components, including Actimize Intelligence Server (AIS), data processing workflows, and supporting application infrastructure.
* Design, develop, and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and processing pipelines to support high-volume transaction monitoring within the Actimize SAM platform.
* Collaborate with Product, Compliance, Risk, and Architecture teams to translate AML monitoring requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Function as a core member of an Agile engineering team, contributing to user story analysis, technical design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Develop and maintain integrations between Actimize SAM and enterprise data sources, databases, and downstream systems.
* Perform SQL query optimization, database performance tuning, and application troubleshooting to improve SAM processing efficiency and platform performance.
* Support Actimize SAM platform upgrades, migrations, enhancements, and modernization initiatives while ensuring system stability and regulatory compliance.
* Develop automation solutions for application deployment, testing, monitoring, and operational support.
* Investigate and resolve complex production issues related to scenario execution, transaction processing, data quality, application performance, and batch processing failures.
* Partner with Architecture, Governance, Risk, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver enterprise-scale AML transaction monitoring capabilities.
* Strengthen platform reliability, observability, scalability, and operational readiness across Actimize SAM applications and supporting data services.
* Mentor junior engineers, establish engineering best practices, and contribute to technical documentation, code reviews, and solution design discussions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering or enterprise application development, including significant hands-on experience with NICE Actimize SAM (Suspicious Activity Monitoring).
* Strong hands-on experience in Actimize SAM development, configuration, customization, implementation, and production support.
* Experience with Actimize Intelligence Server (AIS), SAM application architecture, scenario execution, and data processing components.
* Strong understanding of AML transaction monitoring scenarios, detection logic, thresholds, and transaction processing workflows.
* Proficiency in SQL and programming languages such as Java, Python, or other relevant technologies used for Actimize development and integration.
* Experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or PostgreSQL, including complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
* Experience with ETL processes, data mapping, data validation, and integration of large-scale transactional and customer datasets into Actimize SAM.
* Experience troubleshooting Actimize application performance, batch processing, scenario execution, and data integration issues.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration patterns, APIs, web services, and backend processing systems.
* Experience delivering scalable, secure, and highly available enterprise applications.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to develop technical specifications, document system processing flows, and translate functional requirements into technical implementations.

**Preferred**

* Deep technical expertise in NICE Actimize SAM and AIS, including scenario development, application configuration, deployment, and production troubleshooting.
* Experience with Actimize SAM platform upgrades, version migrations, performance optimization, and modernization initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of Actimize SAM data models, transaction monitoring scenarios, detection logic, and underlying processing architecture.
* Experience optimizing large-scale AML transaction monitoring systems processing high volumes of financial transactions.
* Familiarity with AML regulatory requirements, including BSA/AML, KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), and Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR).
* Experience with cloud technologies, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and integration of Actimize solutions with cloud-based data platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automated testing, and application monitoring tools.
* Familiarity with distributed data processing, messaging frameworks, and enterprise-scale data integration architectures.
* Experience with database query optimization, batch processing performance tuning, and production stability improvements.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, lineage, and regulatory data management practices.
* Exposure to AI/ML-enabled AML transaction monitoring, advanced analytics, and modern financial crime detection capabilities.
* Passion for engineering excellence, platform modernization, and solving complex enterprise-scale AML technology challenges.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Tooling & Automation
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.
  
  
**Vultr Cares**

* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription

**Join Vultr**
Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced
**Dev Engineer**
to serve as the technical owner connecting our engineering alerting to Vultr's new Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai, India, and to build the consolidated single-pane dashboard GIOC will operate from. The ideal candidate looks at five disconnected monitoring consoles and a dozen siloed alert feeds, winces, and then methodically builds the one dashboard that replaces all of them. This is a highly visible, focused role, requiring deep familiarity with Vultr's current architecture, monitoring stack, and operational workflows. This is your opportunity to build the operational backbone GIOC runs on from day one.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The
**Senior Software Engineer — Tooling & Automation**
will own the development of automation, integrations, and unified monitoring capabilities for Vultr’s GIOC in Chennai. The role will connect multiple monitoring, SIEM, infrastructure, and provider platforms into a
**single operational view**
, while automating alert routing, ticketing, paging, escalation, and SLA tracking. The engineer will work closely with Systems, Network, Security, and GIOC teams to improve observability, reduce manual intervention, and enable reliable
**24×7 global infrastructure operations**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze every engineering alert stream across Systems, Network, and Security—including Icinga, Grafana, and SIEM platforms—to determine the optimal integration strategy via webhooks, APIs, or native connectors.
* Develop a robust notification layer that funnels high-priority events into GIOC’s operational toolkit, ensuring critical context remains intact for rapid L1 response.
* Collaborate with cross-functional subject matter experts to align automated routing logic with established escalation and resolution protocols.
* Engineer seamless on-call notification workflows that drive strict adherence to acknowledgment SLAs without requiring manual intervention.
* Architect a comprehensive single-pane dashboard that aggregates monitoring across global providers like Equinix and Airtel, eliminating inefficient tool-switching.
* Define the initial scope for visualization projects alongside leadership to meet aggressive technical and operational milestones.
* Maintain continuous infrastructure visibility by managing side-by-side operations of legacy and modern tools during the GIOC transition phase.
* Integrate health and performance metrics—such as escalation precision and aging—into reporting modules for executive-level status updates.
* Produce detailed documentation for all routing systems and dashboards to ensure long-term maintainability by global operations teams.

**Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of experience in Platform Engineering or similar domains, with significant expertise in NMS platforms, Grafana, and major SIEM environments.
* Profound understanding of Vultr’s existing monitoring ecosystem, infrastructure stack, and standard operational procedures across multiple technical pillars.
* Proven track record of building complex integrations using Python and RESTful APIs over the last three years.
* Extensive experience crafting or customizing sophisticated dashboards via Kibana, Power BI, or similar visualization toolsets.
* Deep knowledge of ITSM workflows—specifically Jira and Mattermost—and the technical mapping of event severity to incident metadata.
* Preference for candidates with experience in 24x7 global NOC/SOC environments and multi-provider datacenter logistics.

**Inclusion & Privacy**
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
  
  
We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
  
  
Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Technical Lead - Software Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Location:
  
  
Chennai,IND
  
  
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
  
  
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
  
  
**Technical Lead - Software:**
Build software that powers semiconductor manufacturing.
  
  
We're looking for a Technical Lead who enjoys solving complex business and engineering problems, not just writing code.
  
  
You will build software that drives semiconductor manufacturing automation, working closely with product teams, domain experts, customers, and engineers to deliver meaningful operational impact.
  
  
This role is for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with sound technical judgement. Someone who can move comfortably across different layers of the system, understand the underlying business problem, and make pragmatic technology decisions that stand the test of time.
  
  
If you’re excited by learning how the business works, challenging assumptions, simplifying complexity, and building high-quality systems end-to-end, we'd love to talk to you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead the design and development of scalable, reliable software solutions for semiconductor manufacturing automation.
* Drive architecture and technical direction across services, making pragmatic technology choices based on scalability, reliability, simplicity, and maintainability.
* Work across the stack when needed, including frontend, backend, databases, messaging, infrastructure, Kubernetes configurations, agentic/AI-powered systems, and helm charts.
* Partner with product managers, customers, and domain experts to understand semiconductor manufacturing workflows and translate operational challenges into effective software solutions.
* Deliver solutions that improve manufacturing outcomes such as productivity, quality, throughput, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Mentor engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and code reviews.
* Improve system reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence.
* Influence product direction through technical judgement and growing domain expertise.

**What We're Looking For**
Core engineering capabilities
  
  

* 8+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production-grade systems.
* Strong foundations in software design, distributed systems, data structures, algorithms, and system architecture.
* Strong experience designing and building backend services using technologies such as Python, TypeScript, NestJS, or similar.
* Experience developing modern web applications using frameworks such as React or Angular.
* Experience selecting and working with relational and NoSQL databases based on application needs.
* Experience in data science, machine learning, reinforcement learning related projects
* Experience designing event-driven architectures and message-based systems.
* Experience deploying, operating, and troubleshooting applications on Kubernetes.
* Experience developing software for complex operational environments such as manufacturing automation, factory operations, industrial engineering, engineering workflows, or productivity platforms is a plus.
* Exposure to AI, machine learning, agentic systems, analytics, optimization, or simulation-based software solutions is a plus.

**More importantly...**
We value engineering judgement over experience with any specific technology.
  
  
You should be able to:
  
  

* Select the right tool for the problem rather than forcing a favorite technology.
* Challenge complexity and simplify architectures where possible.
* Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term maintainability.
* Understand trade-offs and make pragmatic engineering decisions.
* Learn unfamiliar domains quickly and apply that understanding to product decisions.

**You'll thrive here if you...**

* Are curious about how products create business value.
* Enjoy learning domain knowledge, not just technology.
* Take ownership beyond your immediate component or service.
* Can zoom out from implementation details and think at a system level.
* Care deeply about software quality, reliability, and customer outcomes.
* Prefer solving hard problems over working within narrowly defined boundaries.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You become a trusted technical leader across the team.
* Your architectural decisions improve product scalability and maintainability.
* Engineers seek your input on complex technical challenges.
* You influence both technical and product decisions.
* You develop enough semiconductor manufacturing knowledge to help shape solutions, not just implement requirements.

Full time
  
  
**Employee Type:**
Assignee / Regular
  
  
**Travel:**
Not Specified
  
  
**Relocation Eligible:**
Yes

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Corpay is currently looking to hire a Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst. This position falls under our lodging line of business but will also support other areas such as airline and insurance. + Tableau: Strong knowledge of Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server; experience building and maintaining production-level dashboards is essential.
+ Programming Language: Substantial exposure to relational databases and uses of SQL, R and Python
+ Additional Tools: Familiarity with Alteryx or other automated data preparation tools is a plus but not required.

* Analytical Mindset: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data and deliver insights that drive business decisions.
* Industry Background: Previous experience in the lodging or hospitality industry is highly desirable.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to translate data findings into actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving: Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on business impact.

* Successful candidates for this position will have a background in Java or C++. Equally important to these specific skills is a candidate's ability to multi-task, adapt quickly to new development environments and changing business requirements, learn new systems, gain new skills, create reliable & maintainable code, and find creative, scalable solutions to difficult problems.

title: Software Engineer - Advanced
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Simcenter HyperMesh CFD is a powerful pre- and post-processing solution for Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), designed to help engineers efficiently prepare models, generate high-quality meshes, and analyze complex simulation results.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Developer – CFD Post Processing to join our development team and contribute to the continued evolution of the Simcenter HyperMesh CFD (HMCFD) interface.
  
  
In this role, you will design, develop, and enhance GUI-based software capabilities used by engineers working with advanced CFD workflows. You will work closely with software developers, CFD experts, and users to understand technical requirements and translate them into intuitive, reliable, and high-performance software solutions.
  
  
The role provides an opportunity to work across C/C++, Python, Tcl, GUI technologies, CFD, and engineering software, while contributing to a product used in complex engineering workflows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop core product capabilities: Design, implement, test, and enhance software features for the HMCFD graphical user interface using C/C++ and appropriate software engineering practices.
* Build intuitive engineering interfaces: Develop and maintain GUI functionality that enables engineers to efficiently prepare CFD models, interact with simulation data, and perform pre- and post-processing activities.
* Solve complex technical problems: Analyze user and product requirements, investigate technical challenges, and develop robust, maintainable solutions for complex engineering workflows.
* Develop automation and customization: Use Python and Tcl scripting to automate workflows, customize solutions, and improve productivity for specific CFD applications and user requirements.
* Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with software developers, CFD specialists, product teams, and users to understand requirements and deliver effective product capabilities.
* Ensure software quality: Perform development-level testing and QA activities, troubleshoot defects, and contribute to maintaining the reliability and usability of the product.
* Support product adoption: Contribute to technical documentation, user tutorials, and other technical content that helps customers and internal users effectively utilize HMCFD capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong hands-on programming experience in C/C++, with the ability to develop maintainable and production-quality software.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Tcl scripting for automation, customization, and engineering workflows.
* Experience developing GUI-based applications, with a good understanding of user interface design and software interaction patterns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex requirements and translate them into practical software solutions.
* Working knowledge of both Linux and Windows operating systems and experience developing or supporting software in a multiplatform environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with software developers, engineering experts, and end users.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Qt and/or OpenGL.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and common CFD workflows.
* Experience with Simcenter HyperWorks or other CAE/engineering software.
* Experience with CAD modeling or visualization software.
* Knowledge of Finite Element Method (FEM) and structural analysis.
* Experience developing software for engineering, scientific, simulation, or visualization applications.
* Familiarity with scripting-driven engineering workflows and application customization.

description:
**Job Title:**
Next.js Developer Intern
  
  
**Location:**
Remote
  
  
**Duration:**
6 months, full-time
  
  
**Who can apply:**
2025 and 2026 graduates only
  
  
**What This Is**
We're not hiring someone to sit through onboarding decks and shadow meetings. We're looking for someone who actually builds things. If you've spent weekends shipping a side project nobody asked you to build, or your GitHub has commits that exist just because you were curious, you're probably the kind of person we want. The title says intern, but the work is real. You'll touch actual code, work on live products, and have a genuine say in what we build next.
  
  
We work in Next.js end to end. That's what you'll live in for six months.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Do**

* Build and ship features, App Router, SSR/SSG, API routes, the works
* Write UI components that are clean and hold up on mobile
* Wire up APIs and third-party services
* Sit in on product conversations and push back when something doesn't make sense
* Write code you'd be comfortable showing someone else

**What We're Looking For**
The GitHub or portfolio matters more to us than your grades or your GPA. Show us something you built — it doesn't have to be fancy, we just want to see that you actually make things.
  
  
Beyond that: solid React and Next.js knowledge (not just tutorials), comfort with Tailwind and TypeScript, and a working understanding of how APIs function. Git is a given.
  
  
Open to freshers from the 2025 or 2026 batch only — this role is built for people just starting out.
  
  
**Nice to have**
Vercel deployments, any database exposure (Supabase, PostgreSQL, etc.), Figma basics. Not required, just a bonus.

Real product work, not busy work. You'll get direct mentorship, fast feedback loops, and actual ownership over what you ship. Strong performers get a shot at a full-time role. Certificate of completion included.
  
  
**To Apply, Send**

* Your GitHub and/or portfolio link — required, no exceptions
* Your resume
* 2–3 sentences on a project you built: what it does and what you took away from it

No long cover letters. We'll read what you made, not what you wrote about yourself.

**Job details**

* NET Developer (C11)

**Overview**
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled .NET Developer. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, coupled with knowledge of Markets domain in Kazakhstan. This role requires development of the following in-country applications:
  
  

* The in-country applications maintain several critical business functions for Markets Operations, including:

+ Downloading market data, FX, and repo deals from the Kazakhstan stock exchange and their further submission to downstream applications.
+ Downloading swap, spot, and forward deals from upstream applications and their further submission to the Kazakhstan central depository.
+ Downloading exchange rates from the National Bank.
+ Regulatory reporting to the National Bank.
+ Risk reporting to downstream applications.

+ Downloading exchange rates from the National Bank.
+ Regulatory reporting to the National Bank.
+ Reconciliation report submission to downstream applications.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Lead Software Engineer - Backend**

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India (Hybrid)

**About Chargebee:**

Chargebee is a subscription billing and revenue management platform powering some of the fastest-growing brands around the world today, including Lambda.ai, Zapier, Condé Nast, Pret-a-Manger, Freshworks, Okta, Study.com, and others. Thousands of SaaS and subscription-first businesses process billions of dollars in revenue every year through the Chargebee platform.

Headquartered in San Francisco, USA, our 1000+ team members work remotely throughout the world, including India, the Netherlands, Paris, Spain, Australia, and the USA.

Chargebee has raised over $480 million in capital and is funded by Accel, Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Sequoia Capital, Steadview Capital, and Sapphire Ventures. And we’re on a mission to push the boundaries of subscription revenue operations. Not just ours, but every customer and prospective business on a recurring revenue model.

**Job Summary:**

Chargebee is looking for a Lead Software Engineer - Backend to rethink the integrations between CRM and billing in an AI-native way. This role will shape how customers automate sales processes and interact with Chargebee using AI. This team builds best-in-class capabilities that integrate Chargebee with enterprise CRM platforms such as Salesforce and HubSpot, simplifying sales workflows.

This role requires a blend of strong technical expertise, exceptional system design skills, an AI-Native mindset, and a passion for leading and mentoring engineers. As a Lead Software Engineer - Backend, you will lead the development and delivery of key product features, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful execution of innovative, customer-focused solutions. Your role will involve both architectural and hands-on technical contributions to ensure the team delivers scalable, high-quality products that meet business objectives. There will be a clear focus on building AI Native products, so experience in building them is ideal, but otherwise the ability to learn on the job and upskill quickly is mandatory.

**The key responsibilities include:**

* Lead the end-to-end technical design and architecture of of CRM integrations, with a strong focus on scale and data accuracy.
* Develop modular, maintainable, and reliable code that adheres to industry-leading design patterns and security standards.
* Participate actively in cross-functional forums, making well-reasoned, opinionated decisions on integration architecture to ensure reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers to translate business requirements into robust, scalable CRM connectors and integration workflows.
* Write hands-on, production-quality code to build frameworks and middleware that underpin seamless integrations.
* Champion AI adoption in the team and drive the development of AI-native functionalities.
* Author and maintain technical documentation, API specifications, and implementation guides that serve as clear references for engineering and solution consulting teams.
* Own integration quality end-to-end — through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, data validation, and API automation, while proactively identifying and resolving data sync or API consumption issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve customer-reported integration issues with urgency, transparency, and clear communication.
* Mentor and coach engineers on best practices for building scalable, resilient integrations, fostering a culture of technical excellence.
* Champion Agile practices within the team, driving iterative delivery and continuous improvement.

**What You Bring:**

* 7+ years of proven experience designing and building enterprise-scale SaaS platforms, with solid exposure to distributed backend systems.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in Java, RESTful APIs, and OLTP databases.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture, microservices, and industry best practices for operating at large scale.
* Passionate about AI-powered automation and curious about how agentic approaches can transform enterprise workflows.
* Experience building, supporting, and optimizing production systems, with a proven track record of identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks.
* Proficiency in enterprise-scale monitoring and observability using modern tooling.
* Ability to balance pragmatism with vision, delivering incremental value today while laying the foundation for future scale.
* Demonstrated success in fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, accountability, and customer focus.
* Strong ability to identify gaps in requirements, evaluate alternatives, and guide your team through ambiguity.
* Thrives in fast-paced, collaborative environments and can rally teams around complex technical missions.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with comfort engaging cross-functional stakeholders at all levels.

**Added Advantage:**

* Hands-on experience building or contributing to AI-native products.
* Prior experience building a CRM or integrating with enterprise CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

**What makes us who we are:**

* **We are Globally Local**
  : With a diverse team across four continents and customers in over 60 countries, you get to work closely with a global perspective right from your own neighborhood.
* **We value Curiosity**
  : We believe the next great idea might just be around the corner. Perhaps it’s that random thought you had ten minutes ago. We believe in creating an ecosystem that fosters a desire to seek out hard questions, figure out answers to them, and foster a continuous learning environment.
* **Customer! Customer! Customer!**
  : Everything we do is driven towards enabling our customers’ growth. This means no matter what you do, you will always be adding real value to a real business problem. It’s a lot of responsibility, but also a lot of fun.

title: AI-Native Software Engineer
description:
**What is Contentstack?**
Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.
  
  
While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.
  
  
Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.
  
  
Learn more at www.contentstack.com.
  
  
**Who Are We?**
At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let's go!
  
  

* What you will be working on

**Assets Platform Development**

* **Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs for managing assets**
  , including organization structures, folders, files, and metadata, along with their create, update, and delete flows.
* **Implement and evolve access control and permission features**
  , including sharing assets with users and teams and managing visibility settings.
* **Build features for secure and performant asset delivery**
  , including CDN delivery, caching, and event driven integrations with other platform services.
* **Build and enhance image editing capabilities**
  such as cropping, resizing, rotation, format conversion, compression, and on-the-fly image transformations for delivery.
* **Build and enhance video editing and processing capabilities**
  such as trimming, transcoding, thumbnail generation, and optimized streaming and playback.
* **Explore and integrate AI-powered media features**
  such as smart cropping, background removal, auto-tagging, and automated metadata generation for images and videos.
* **Build and improve asset usage tracking**
  , so users can see where assets are referenced before changing or deleting them.
* **Contribute to upcoming roadmap areas**
  around security, collaboration, and sharing. Roles & Responsibilities

**AI-Native Engineering Practice**

* **Use AI tools and agents as your primary development partners**
  for designing, writing, refactoring, testing, and reviewing code, while staying fully accountable for the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything you ship.
* **Break down product requirements into technical designs and implementation plans**
  with AI assistance, and validate them against the existing architecture and constraints.
* **Build and maintain reusable prompts, agent workflows, and project context**
  so the rest of the team can adopt the same AI SDLC practices.
* **Use AI agents for multi-step work**
  such as large refactors, API changes, test generation, and bug triage.
* **Measure and share the impact of AI-driven workflows**
  on cycle time, quality, and defect rates, and continuously improve the team's practices.
* **Follow company policies on data privacy and security**
  when using AI tools, especially around customer data, secrets, and asset content.

**Quality, Reliability, and Operations**

* **Own quality end to end**
  , with no separate QA hand-off. This includes writing and maintaining automated tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) with AI assistance, covering core flows such as upload, retrieval, editing, delivery, and permissions.
* **Oversee AI-driven code reviews**
  by setting review standards, validating AI findings, and giving final approval before changes are merged.
* **Investigate and resolve production issues and customer-reported bugs**
  , using AI to speed up log analysis, root-cause analysis, and fix verification.
* **Participate in on-call rotations and incident response**
  , and contribute to runbooks and postmortems.
* **Keep technical documentation current**
  , including API docs, design documents, and onboarding guides, using AI to draft and maintain them.

**Collaboration**

* **Work closely with Product, Design, and partner engineering teams**
  on cross-team features. Mentor other engineers on effective, responsible AI-assisted development.

**Mandatory Skills**

* **6+ years of professional software engineering experience**
  building backend services and APIs.
* Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI coding tools and agents in daily work, with concrete examples of shipping production features through AI-driven workflows.
* **Strong skills in prompt design**
  , providing effective context to AI tools, and critically evaluating AI output.
* **Experience with distributed systems**
  , REST and gRPC APIs, event-driven architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
* **Solid understanding of access control**
  , data security, and multi-tenant SaaS systems.
* **Strong testing discipline and debugging skills**
  , with experience owning quality without a dedicated QA function.

**What Do We Offer?**
**Interesting Work |**
We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the "challenge yourself" role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you're doing it.
  
  
**Tribe Vibe**
| We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict "no a\*\*hole policy" and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.
  
  
**Bragging Rights**
| We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!
  
  
**One Team One Dream**
| This is one of our values, and it shows. We don't believe in artificial hierarchies. If you're part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it's a great time to be joining…

title: Distinguished, Software Engineering

What You’ll Bring
  
  
15+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Distributed Systems, or Enterprise Architecture.
  
  
Proven expertise building and operating large-scale data platforms, real-time systems, and cloud-native applications.
  
  
Deep understanding of enterprise data architecture, AI/ML platforms, security architecture, governance, and software engineering best practices.
  
  
Strong hands-on coding experience in Java, Scala, Python, SQL, and modern cloud technologies.

Experience influencing senior executives and driving alignment across large engineering organizations without direct authority.
  
  
Proven track record of mentoring senior technical leaders and scaling engineering excellence.
  
  
Experience building enterprise Data & AI platforms supporting analytics, personalization, customer intelligence, optimization, and Agentic AI solutions.
  
  
Expertise in data platform modernization, platform engineering, security engineering, and cloud transformation.
  
  
Experience operating across global markets and highly regulated environments.
  
  

* Contributions to patents, publications, open-source projects, or industry thought leadership. Previous experience as a Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow, or equivalent senior technical leadership role.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior .NET Developer/Technical Lead with 10+ years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering scalable enterprise applications using C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, and Microsoft Azure. * Develop data access solutions using Entity Framework Core.

* Proficiency in C# and .NET Core: Minimum 10 years of experience.
* Strong experience with SQL Server for database design, development, and optimization.
* Expertise in Entity Framework and Entity Framework Core for ORM and data access.
* Hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, App Service, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps).
* Proficiency in designing and developing microservices architecture, with experience in Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration.
* In-depth knowledge of design patterns for scalable and maintainable code architecture.
* Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms with practical application experience.
* Experience in RESTful API design, with knowledge of Swagger/OpenAPI, OAuth2.0, and JWT for API security.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks (e.g., xUnit, NUnit), and version control systems (Git, GitFlow).
* Strong context switching ability, with the capacity to manage multiple products and shift focus between tasks efficiently.

* Familiarity with nHibernate and OData for advanced data access techniques.
* Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodologies.
* Understanding of Zeebe (workflow engine) and SignalR (real-time web functionality).
* Proficiency in PowerShell for scripting and automation tasks.
* Familiarity with identity management systems such as Keycloak and Azure AD for authentication and authorization.

**Education & Experience Requirements**

* Sound experience of designing and developing applications both individually and as part of a team
* Knowledge of a commodity or financial trading environment useful but not a pre-requisite
* Strong inter-personal and communication skills (both verbal and written)
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to develop innovative solutions to technical problems
* Experience of working in an Agile/Scrum team environment
* Educated to Degree-level (or equivalent), as a minimum requirement

Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life.
  
  
With over 140,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices.
  
  
Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

title: Senior Engineer Controls
description:
**About Us:**
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
  
  
What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.
  
  
In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
  
  
**Our culture is built on:**

* Ownership – Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**
At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
  
  
If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Description:**
The Senior Controls Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and lifecycle management of software for industrial automation and control systems. This role involves developing PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion control, and industrial communication solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams throughout the complete project lifecycle—from concept and design through commissioning and customer support.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, industrial networking, and machine automation
**using Siemens, Beckhoff, Bosch Rexroth, B&R automation platforms or a combination of these automation platforms.**
**Essential duties and responsibilities:**

* Design and develop machine control software for custom automation systems from concept through commissioning.
* Develop PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion control, safety, and industrial communication software.
* Configure and integrate servo drives, VFDs, robotics, vision systems, and field devices.
* Prepare Functional Design Specifications (FDS), I/O lists, software architecture, and technical documentation.
* Perform software testing, debugging, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and customer support.
* Collaborate with Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, and Project Engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Participate in the review of electrical designs, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards.
* Troubleshoot control systems and optimize machine performance.
* Participate in software code reviews and maintain software quality standards.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives, software standardization, and engineering best practices.

* Release note reviews
* Preview tenant testing
* Regression testing

* Partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, Employee Experience, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver technical solutions.
* Participate in cross-functional project teams supporting new implementations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with global teams across APAC, EMEA, and North America.

* Mentor junior developers, analysts, and operational teams on Workday integrations, reporting, calculated fields, and platform best practices.
* Support knowledge transfer initiatives and promote self-service reporting capabilities within business functions.
* Contribute to team capability development through training, documentation, and peer coaching.

* Participate in continuous learning and evaluation of emerging Workday technologies, testing tools, and platform capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Workday Studio
* Core Connectors
* EIBs
* RaaS
* Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST)
* Middleware integrations
* ISU management
* Strong experience developing and supporting Workday reporting solutions, including:
* Advanced Reports
* Matrix Reports
* BIRT Reports
* Dashboards and scheduled reporting
* Experience supporting full project lifecycles including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across HR, Finance, Payroll, and IT organizations.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments and Jira-based project management processes.
* Demonstrated commitment to documentation, governance, and operational excellence.

* Exposure to Workday Financials, including Financial Data Model (FDM) concepts and financial reporting requirements.
* Experience supporting Procure-to-Pay, Invoice-to-Cash, or Record-to-Report business processes.
* Familiarity with Workday Security concepts including role-based and user-based security groups.

* Workday certifications in Integrations, Reporting, HCM, or Financials.
* Experience leveraging AI-enabled productivity tools such as ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, NotebookLM, or similar technologies.

**Success Profile**

title: Senior Java Developer - Vice President
description:
The Opportunity: Are You Ready to Build the Future of Risk Analytics?
  
  
Want to solve one of the most challenging big data problems in finance today? Are you excited by the idea of working directly with front-office and risk quants on massive-scale analytics for critical regulations like FRTB? Do you want to tame billions of rows of complex financial data with Apache Spark and deliver insights to senior leaders in a fraction of a second?
  
  
Citi is looking for an elite, hands-on technologist to engineer the next-generation analytics platform for our Market Risk organization. This isn't just another data job. You will be the architect and builder of a high-performance system that ingests, processes, and serves petabytes of risk calculation data, making it instantly accessible and understandable to the entire firm.
  
  
Your Role and Impact
  
  
As a Senior Technologist, you will be at the heart of the action, designing the systems that power our most sophisticated risk-based calculations. You will take the raw, trade-level Present Value (PV) outputs from our Historical VaR and FRTB Expected Shortfall engines and transform them into a strategic data asset.
  
  
Your impact will be immediate and far-reaching. You will build the data pipelines that handle immense volumes, create intelligent APIs that democratize data access, and leverage cutting-edge OLAP and NLP technologies to provide unparalleled drill-down and analytical capabilities. You will be the go-to expert who empowers senior stakeholders in the Markets and Risk organizations to make faster, smarter decisions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect and build robust, scalable data pipelines to ingest and process billions of trade-level PV calculations from various stress engines.
* Develop and optimize large-scale aggregation jobs using Apache Spark, ensuring high performance and efficiency.
* Design and deliver a suite of "intelligent data APIs" that provide flexible, on-demand access to both aggregated and non-aggregated risk data for teams across the firm.
* Integrate Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities to create intuitive, query-based interfaces for data exploration, lowering the barrier to entry for complex analytics.
* Load and model massive aggregated datasets into high-performance OLAP engines like Apache Pinot, Apache Druid, and Trino.
* Build powerful, interactive analytical tools and dashboards on top of the OLAP layer, providing summary views and lightning-fast drill-down capabilities.
* Partner directly with senior stakeholders in the Front Office, Quantitative teams, and Risk Management to understand their analytical needs and deliver innovative solutions.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 10+ years of experience with Strong programming skills in Python, Java and/or Scala, and expert-level SQL.
* A true passion for data, analytics, and solving complex problems at massive scale.
* A degree in a quantitative or technical field such as Computer Science, Financial Mathematics, or Financial Engineering.
* Expert-level, hands-on experience with big data technologies, particularly Apache Spark.
* Proven experience with high-performance OLAP databases such as Apache Pinot, Apache Druid, or Trino.
* Strong background in fundamental computer science concepts, including data structures and algorithms.
* A mindset for 'AI-first' development, constantly looking for ways to embed intelligence into systems.
* Experience or a strong interest in applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) to data access and analytics.
* A knack for solving 'needle in a haystack' problems, with a talent for debugging complex data and access issues.
* Experience in the financial industry with an understanding of market risk, derivatives, and risk calculations (VaR, Stress Testing, PV) is highly desirable.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and lead technical projects.
* Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to collaborate with senior business and quantitative stakeholders.

title: Associate Software Engineer Intern - YMS
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
Kaleris builds Yard Management Systems (YMS) that control and optimize the movement of goods throughout the supply chain — across gates, yards, docks, and drivers. We are actively expanding our YMS platform with new automation capabilities including gate intelligence, real-time yard visibility, and driver self-service workflows.
  
  
As an intern on this team, you'll contribute to real engineering problems on a live product. You'll be assigned to one or more focus areas based on team needs and your own strengths — which may shift during the internship as priorities evolve. You should be comfortable with ambiguity and self-directed enough to ramp up on a new area with limited hand-holding.
  
  
**What You May Work On**
Your work will fall within either of the following areas, depending on where the team needs you most:
  
  

* Gate Automation & Computer Vision (Research & Prototype)
* Explore and prototype computer vision and OCR approaches for automated detection of truck and trailer data at yard gates — trailer numbers, license plates, cab numbers, USDOT numbers, and seal presence
* Build and evaluate training data pipelines using publicly available datasets and real-world gate imagery
* Benchmark detection accuracy and document what is achievable in-house vs. what would require significant investment
* Assess feasibility of running detection models on edge hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson or equivalent)
* YMS Platform Feature Development
* Work on backend features within the Kaleris YMS platform — contributing to gate workflow logic, shipment management, dock door assignments, or yard inventory tracking
* Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews
* Help reduce manual data entry pain points through automation and smarter integrations

**Required**
**What You Bring**

* Currently pursuing a B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field (final or pre-final year)
* Solid programming fundamentals in at least one language — Python, Java, or similar
* Any hands-on project or coursework involving computer vision, OCR, or machine learning (academic, personal, or Kaggle — show us the code)
* Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow, and Python data libraries (OpenCV, NumPy)
* Ability to pick up new technologies independently — you won't have a dedicated senior in every focus area
* Clear written communication — you'll need to document your work and surface blockers clearly
* Genuine curiosity about how software solves real operational problems

**Good To Have**

* Web development experience — frontend or backend
* Ruby on Rails familiarity — our YMS platform has Rails components; any Rails or web backend experience is a strong plus
* Exposure to REST APIs, event-driven systems, or database design
* Interest in logistics, yard/warehouse operations, or supply chain technology

**What You'll Get**

* Exposure to a real, production YMS platform used by major logistics operators
* Ownership of a meaningful deliverable — not a sandbox exercise
* Flexibility to contribute across different areas of the product based on where you add the most value

Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Lead Python Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum**
is looking for a
**Lead Python Engineer**
to join our team full-time in India.
  
  
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Lead Python Engineer with 12+ years of experience to lead the design and development of advanced backend systems and AI-powered platforms. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Python-based backend architecture, scalable API design, cloud infrastructure, and modern AI technologies such as Generative AI and Agentic AI. This role will be responsible for architecting end-to-end AI solutions, guiding engineering teams, and driving the adoption of cutting-edge AI technologies across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Architecture & Technical Leadership

+ Design and architect scalable backend platforms using Python and FastAPI
+ Define technical standards, architecture patterns, and best practices for backend and AI systems
+ Lead the development of high-performance microservices and API ecosystems

* AI Solution Development

+ Architect and deliver end-to-end AI applications using Generative AI and Agentic AI frameworks
+ Design AI-driven workflows, autonomous agents, and intelligent automation systems
+ Integrate LLMs, AI models, and vector-based retrieval systems into enterprise applications

* Data & Platform Engineering

+ Design and optimize data architectures leveraging SQL databases and Databricks (Genie & NLQ)
+ Build scalable data processing pipelines and AI-ready data platforms
+ Ensure high-performance data retrieval, processing, and analytics integration

* Cloud & Infrastructure Strategy

+ Lead deployment and infrastructure strategies across Azure or AWS environments
+ Architect cloud-native solutions, containerized deployments, and scalable infrastructure
+ Ensure systems meet enterprise-grade security, reliability, and scalability requirements

* Technical Mentorship

+ Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams
+ Conduct architecture reviews and code quality assessments
+ Guide teams in adopting emerging AI technologies and engineering best practices

* Cross-functional Collaboration

+ Collaborate with data scientists, product leaders, and business stakeholders to define AI-driven solutions
+ Translate complex business problems into scalable technical architectures
+ Drive innovation through AI experimentation and rapid prototyping

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* 12+ years of experience in software engineering, including backend and AI-based application development
* Programming & Backend Architecture

+ Expert-level proficiency in Python
+ Strong experience with FastAPI or modern Python backend frameworks
+ Deep understanding of API architecture, microservices, and distributed systems

* Database & Data Platforms

+ Advanced expertise in SQL
+ Experience with Databricks (Genie & NLQ)
+ Strong knowledge of RDBMS systems (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, etc.)

* Cloud & Infrastructure

+ Extensive experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS
+ Knowledge of cloud-native architecture and scalable deployments

* Artificial Intelligence

+ Proven experience building end-to-end applications using Generative AI or Agentic AI
+ Strong understanding of LLM integrations, AI orchestration frameworks, and intelligent automation

**Desirable**

* Front End : React +tailwind
* AWS Bedrock and Agentcore
* Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar LLM orchestration frameworks
* Knowledge of vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
* Exposure to MLOps and AI model deployment pipelines

**What`s in it for you?**

* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

**About Us**
At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
  
  
India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
  
  
Want to learn more about us? Follow us on Instagram , Facebook , LinkedIn .
  
  
**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

title: SAP ABAP Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Enterprise Performance**
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level: SAP ABAP Senior Consultant**
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.

As an SAP ABAP Senior Consultant, you will develop programs across all RICEFW components and process areas, ensuring high-quality deliverables in line with our CMMI-certified standards. Responsibilities include reviewing functional specifications, preparing technical documentation, translating requirements into efficient code, and performing thorough technical unit testing. You will be accountable for maintaining comprehensive documentation throughout the build phase and actively participating in review processes, including self and peer reviews.
  
  

* Collaborate with functional teams for issue resolution
* Track timesheets accurately
* Use project management tools as trained
* Capture minutes of meetings (MOM) during technical reviews
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Work effectively within structured, process-driven environments

Deloitte’s SAP Service Line is among the world’s largest, with 8,000 global practitioners and over 1,700 SAP implementation projects completed. More than half our consultants have 10+ years of experience, and Deloitte has been an SAP Global Partner — Services since 1989. We offer a full range of SAP services, from business case development to deployment, supported by nine solution centers and proprietary accelerators that enhance project delivery. Our CMMI Level 5 and SAS 70-certified practice covers S4 Hana, CRM, NetWeaver, BO, Development, BASIS & Infrastructure, and serves all functional areas and industry sectors.
  
  
**Qualifications:**
**Must have Skills:**

* 6-10 Years of hands-on experience with SAP ABAP
* Hands-on experience with S/4HANA implementation projects
* Proficiency in core ABAP areas:

+ Reports (including ALV)
+ Interfaces (file-based; optionally IDOC, ALE, etc.)
+ Enhancements (User Exits, Customer Exits, BADI; optionally BTE, Enhancement Framework in S/4HANA)
+ Adobe Forms
+ Conversions (including BDC, BAPI; optionally LSMW)

* Experience in Core Data Services (CDS) development
* Technical involvement in at least one full-cycle implementation project
* Good understanding of the Functional Processes
* Experience of writing technical specification document
* Good communication skills

**Good to have Skills:**

* Experience in any additional skill area such as Integration, SAP UI5, SAP BTP, MDG, or EWM Technical

**Must have Skills:**
SAP ABAP+ (BTP/UI5/O Data/CDS/TM/BRIM/VIM/Public Cloud)
  
  
**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays.
