title: Senior Software Engineer (.Net)
description:
**About NCR VOYIX**
NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.
  
  
**Senior Software Engineer**
**Location:**
Chennai, India
  
  
**Job Summary**
NCR VOYIX is seeking a highly motivated and talented Senior Software Engineer to join our Retail Software Engineering team. This role is responsible for the design, development, modernization, implementation, and support of software solutions for retail and store technology products.
  
  
As a senior engineer, you will drive technical solutions from concept through delivery, contribute to architectural and design decisions, mentor team members, and help modernize applications through cloud-native technologies, automation, DevOps practices, and AI-assisted software development. You will collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product teams, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and customer-focused solutions.
  
  
**We're searching for you if you:**

* Are passionate about software engineering and emerging technologies.
* Enjoy solving complex technical challenges and driving innovative solutions.
* Take ownership of features and systems from design through production support.
* Thrive in collaborative environments and can influence technical decisions across teams.
* Enjoy mentoring engineers and sharing technical expertise.
* Have a modernization mindset and embrace continuous learning.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of enterprise retail software solutions.
* Develop scalable, secure, and maintainable applications using C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET, REST APIs, JavaScript, SQL Server, and related technologies.
* Drive technical design, architecture discussions, and implementation decisions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software and resolve complex technical issues.
* Lead modernization initiatives including cloud adoption, API-driven development, microservices, automation, containerization, and CI/CD.
* Conduct code reviews, promote engineering best practices, and mentor team members.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while ensuring quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Create technical documentation and support production deployments, release management, and operational excellence.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 7+ years of software development experience, including enterprise application development using C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET, REST APIs, JavaScript, SQL Server, XML, and relational databases.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, object-oriented programming, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, secure coding, testing methodologies, and code review practices.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, NuGet, Nexus Repository, Artifactory, SpecFlow, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automated testing, and Agile methodologies.
* Experience building API-driven, distributed, service-oriented, or microservices-based applications, with exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-native architectures.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and leading application modernization, cloud migration, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience using AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, or ChatGPT to support development, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.
* Strong technical leadership, mentoring, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical direction and lead initiatives across teams.
* Retail, commerce, pricing, inventory, accounting, tax reporting, or related domain experience is a plus.

This job description outlines the primary duties and responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be exhaustive. Employees may be required to undertake additional responsibilities consistent with their skills, experience, and the overall purpose of the position.
  
  
Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

title: Software Engineer - Java & Kubernetes
description:
**About Us**
One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Our team builds and maintains the core backend architecture and orchestration engines that power our high-scale production systems. We bridge traditional backend software engineering with modern cloud-native deployment and automated workflow pipelines.
  
  
In this role, you will be exposed to enterprise-scale distributed systems, container orchestration at scale, and end-to-end data pipeline automation. You will use your Java expertise to build robust backend microservices while leveraging Python and Apache Airflow to orchestrate complex scheduled workflows. By deploying and managing these components within Kubernetes, you will ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and smooth deployment cycles.
  
  
Your work directly controls how our core application logic and automated workflows run in production. By keeping our Kubernetes deployments resilient and our Airflow pipelines performing efficiently, you ensure seamless service uptime, rapid deployment of new features, and reliable data delivery for end users.
  
  
**The day-to-day**

* Feature Integration & Development: Writing clean, scalable, and well-tested Java code to build and extend core backend microservices.
* Workflow Orchestration: Designing, building, and maintaining Apache Airflow DAGs and Python scripts to automate multi-step processing jobs and background tasks.
* Kubernetes Orchestration: Writing and updating Kubernetes manifests and Helm charts to manage application pods, service configurations, and scaling strategies.
* Continuous Deployment: Automating build, test, and release processes to support zero-downtime continuous deployment to production users.
* Operations & Monitoring: Troubleshooting container performance, monitoring cluster health, and resolving production bottlenecks across Java services and Airflow runners.

**What You'll Need**

* Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional software development experience.
* Core Language: Strong proficiency in Java and its ecosystem, with a solid understanding of object-oriented programming.
* Orchestration: Hands-on commercial experience with Docker and Kubernetes (K8s). You should be comfortable managing pods, deployments, services, and configurations.
* Workflow Tools: Practical experience building and maintaining pipelines in Apache Airflow.
* Secondary Language: Proficiency in Python for scripting, data processing, and Airflow DAG creation.
* Version Control & CI/CD: Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).

**What Will Help You On The Job**

* Ability to work on distributed remote agile teams with a high degree of self-motivation and ability to work independently.
* Exposure to GraalVm is an additional plus
* Experience with cloud platforms GCP
* CI/CD and Devops exposure is a strong plus
* Travel Requirement: Up to 10%

title: Lead Developer - Java and Microservices
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and technically accomplished
**Application Dev Lead**
to join our team, responsible for architecting, developing, and leading our core banking integration strategies and modern microservices ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert in integration technologies, possess deep, hands-on expertise in
**Java Microservices and enterprise Database engineering (Oracle/SQL)**
, have extensive knowledge of the financial services domain, and demonstrate a proven track record of leading technical teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure solutions.
  
  
This role requires a unique blend of hands-on technical excellence, architectural vision, database performance optimization, and strong people management skills to drive the modernization and stability of our mission-critical banking systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Leadership & People Management**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of developers, backend engineers, and integration specialists, fostering technical capability, career growth, and engineering excellence across Java microservices and middleware platforms.
* Project & Delivery Ownership: Take full ownership of technical delivery across complex integration initiatives, including architectural scoping, task breakdown (WBS), accurate sprint estimation, resource planning, and milestone prioritization.
* Quality Assurance & Engineering Governance: Enforce best-in-class engineering practices by conducting rigorous code reviews, pull request audits, and comprehensive architectural design reviews (TDRs).
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate seamlessly across business lines, enterprise architecture, database administrators, infrastructure, Information Security, and third-party vendor teams to align technical delivery with strategic business goals.
* SME & Agile Delivery: Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex escalations, production incident triage (Sev-1/MIM), and root-cause analysis, while driving Agile/Scrum ceremonies to ensure predictable, high-quality, and timely delivery.

**Technical & Domain Responsibilities**

* Java Microservices Architecture: Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, containerized Java microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and RESTful/gRPC APIs, implementing distributed resilience patterns (Saga orchestrations, Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads, Outbox pattern).
* Database Engineering & Query Performance: Design robust database models and persistence layers (Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, JDBC), execute query tuning, analyze execution plans (EXPLAIN PLAN), optimize indexing strategies (B-Tree, Bitmap, composite), and resolve connection pool (HikariCP) and row-level locking contentions in enterprise Oracle/SQL environments.
* High-Availability Integration Design: Design and implement resilient, distributed integration solutions prioritizing active-active high availability (HA), fault tolerance, multi-region disaster recovery (DR), recoverability, and minimal business disruption.
* Legacy-to-Cloud Modernization: Lead the architectural evolution and phased decomposition of legacy centralized middleware (TIBCO BusinessWorks, IBM MQ) into distributed, event-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka and cloud-native Java microservices.
* Banking Domain Systems Integration: Apply deep expertise in banking and financial services to integration architecture, specifically in real-time fraud detection, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT, Fedwire, ACH), clearing and settlement, and core enterprise banking ledgers.
* Security, Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all integration services strictly comply with enterprise security baselines, audit controls, regulatory mandates (OCC, Fed, PRA, MAS), data protection rules (PII, PCI-DSS), Mutual TLS (mTLS) certificate management, and operational resilience standards.
* High-Volume Real-Time Messaging: Oversee the architecture, throughput tuning, and management of real-time transaction flows, high-volume messaging pipelines, dead-letter queue (DLQ) automation, and sub-second SLA routing.

**Recommended Qualifications**
**Core Technical Skills**

* Java & Microservices:

+ Advanced proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), Multithreading, Concurrency, and JVM tuning (Memory management, Garbage Collection - G1GC/ZGC).
+ Hands-on mastery of Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch).
+ Deep experience with Microservices patterns (Saga Orchestration/Choreography, CQRS, Circuit Breaker via Resilience4j, API Gateway routing).
+ Containerization and orchestration experience using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.

* Database & Data Persistence:

+ Advanced expertise in Relational Databases: Oracle (19c+), SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers.
+ Deep knowledge of Query Performance Tuning, Execution Plan analysis (EXPLAIN PLAN), index design, partitioning, and stats gathering.
+ Mastery of connection pool management (HikariCP), lock contention mitigation, deadlock resolution, and transaction isolation levels (READ COMMITTED, SERIALIZABLE).
+ Solid understanding of ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA) and mitigation of ORM antipatterns (N+1 queries, dirty checks).

* Enterprise Middleware & Messaging:

+ Subject Matter Expertise in TIBCO technologies: TIBCO BusinessWorks (BW 5.x / 6.x), TIBCO Enterprise Message Service (EMS), TIBCO Administrator/TEA.
+ In-depth experience with enterprise queuing and streaming: IBM MQ and Apache Kafka (Topic design, Partitioning, Consumer Groups, Schema Registry).

* APIs & Protocols:

+ Contract-first API development: RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger, SOAP Web Services, gRPC.
+ Data formatting & transformation: JSON, XML, XSD, WSDL, XPath, XSLT, and Canonical Data Modeling.

* Security & Cryptography:

+ Solid foundation in transport and application security: SSL/TLS 1.3, Mutual TLS (mTLS), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Keystores/Truststores, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, and API Key/Token management.

* DevOps, CI/CD & Observability:

+ Build & CI/CD toolchains: Git, Maven, Gradle, Harness, TeamCity, Jenkins, uDeploy.
+ Comprehensive monitoring & logging: Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Micrometer, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/Zipkin).

**Good To Have Skills**

+ Automated Testing & Quality Engineering:

- Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).
- Familiarity with unit and integration testing frameworks such as JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, and Spring Boot Test.
- Experience with API contract testing tools (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract) and performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling).
- Knowledge of automated code quality gates and static analysis tools (SonarQube, Checkstyle).

**Banking Domain Expertise**

- Deep expertise in banking and financial services integration architecture and enterprise application patterns.
- Proven experience with real-time fraud detection pipelines, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, Fedwire, NACHA/ACH, RTP), core ledger accounting, and trade/transaction processing systems.
- In-depth knowledge of real-time transactional flows, straight-through processing (STP), guaranteed exactly-once delivery, idempotency key patterns, and high-volume messaging resilience.
- Hands-on familiarity with global banking regulations, audit readiness, operational resilience standards, and data protection frameworks (GLBA, GDPR, PCI-DSS).

**Leadership & Management**

- Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams of developers, backend engineers, and integration architects.
- Proven ability to manage full end-to-end technical delivery, including architectural roadmapping, scope definition, backlog grooming, estimation, and task prioritization.
- Track record of establishing engineering best practices, leading code reviews, reducing technical debt, and elevating team capabilities in modern technologies.
- Exceptional stakeholder management, technical communication, and presentation skills across technical teams and executive business sponsors.
- Strong proficiency in driving agile project delivery using Scrum/Kanban methodologies, sprint planning, and release governance.

Developer SSIS C# SQL

**About Business line/Function:**
Under BNP Paribas IT Group, ITTF FRS is the IT framework encompassing Projects & Systems of Finance and RISK functions, with a strong focus on efficiency, proximity, agility and time-to-market.
  
  
FRS is a worldwide organizational model that will contribute to tackle major challenges of the Group’s transformation of today and tomorrow, building the best offering to the Finance and Risk Community through a progressive rotation to new technologies and best practices. The FRS organization is the outcome of several convergences: between the Project & Systems teams of Group Finance, CIB Finance and RISK and their related IT teams.
  
  
FRS is part of the IT Group organization (ITG in Europe and ITO overseas) with a threefold sponsorship by ITG, Finance and RISK (CIB-ITO; RISK Solutions and ITG-FIT).
  
  
****Position Purpose:****
XGEN is an application used to control and transform data into the format expected by regulators. It contributes to the production of the Group financial reporting for banking and market authorities.
  
  
The application is continuously evolving from both a technical and functional perspective in order to address frequent regulatory changes requested by supervisory and regulatory authorities.
  
  
The candidate will join the ITG-ITTF-SDE team and will contribute to the implementation, maintenance and evolution of XGEN. The role will mainly involve analysis, technical design, SSIS development, SQL development, testing, documentation and production support.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with French & Indian teams, business analysts, production teams and development teams in an international environment.

* Participate in testing phases, including technical tests, regression tests and support to user acceptance testing.

* Analyze and correct incidents in collaboration with Production and Development teams.

* Strong expertise in SQL.

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Viamagus Select | Full-time | 5+ years

About Us

Viamagus Select is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help build technology that makes healthcare easier to access and improves the patient experience. You’ll work at the intersection of cloud computing, generative AI, and healthcare, developing voice-based and conversational applications that help patients navigate the healthcare system.

This is a hands-on engineering role with technical leadership, customer collaboration, requirements ownership, and production delivery responsibilities. You’ll work with a distributed engineering team and collaborate directly with US-based startup clients and partner teams.

What You’ll Do

* Build Python applications and scalable services that automate patient interactions with healthcare systems.
* Design and develop applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Lead a local development team and serve as a technical point of contact for complex architectural and implementation challenges.
* Turn ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable engineering requirements.
* Work directly with customers and product owners to clarify requests and agree on scope, priorities, and trade-offs.
* Lead requirements gathering for projects that may span multiple people and months.
* Identify and manage technical, architectural, and delivery risks early.
* Build, test, and maintain applications in a full CI/CD environment.
* Develop high-performance, low-latency services and troubleshoot production issues.
* Integrate user-facing components through server-side logic, working closely with front-end developers.
* Partner with Data Science teams to deploy machine-learning models and integrate them with existing APIs.
* Coordinate with customers and partner teams to deliver product requirements.

What You’ll Bring

* 5+ years of total IT experience.
* 4+ years of Python development experience, with a strong record of delivering successful projects.
* 3+ years of software engineering experience on a software team.
* 2+ years of experience developing applications in a cloud environment, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with at least one Python framework, such as Django, FastAPI, Flask, or Pyramid.
* Experience working in a full CI/CD environment.
* Experience coordinating with Data Science teams to deploy machine-learning models into production.
* Strong communication and customer collaboration skills, including the ability to clarify under-specified requirements and explain technical trade-offs.
* A track record of taking ownership and delivering reliable software.

Nice to Have

* Working knowledge of React and other front-end technologies.
* Experience with Redux.
* Exposure to machine-learning models and techniques.
* Experience working with healthcare data.
* Experience delivering products for startup clients or collaborating with distributed teams.

Education

BE, BTech, or MTech.

Why Join

Help build practical software in an industry that matters. You’ll work on cloud-based healthcare products that use voice applications, conversational AI, and machine learning to make patient access more scalable and intuitive.

Apply

If you enjoy solving complex engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building software that improves the patient experience, we’d like to hear from you.

description:
****Company Overview****
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.
   

  

****Job Description/Preferred Qualifications****
 Job Description/Preferred Qualifications
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Candidate should have Doctorate/Master's degree in either of Physics, Engineering Physics, Engineering Design, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Materials and Metallurgical Engineering.
   

  

 Knowledge in instrumentation, signal processing and optical/electro\-optical systems such as electron microscopes is preferred.
   

  

 Experience with Vacuum Systems, Electron Optics, and High Voltage for scanning electron microscopes or equivalent a plus.
   

  

 Hands\-on experiences in machine control and/or scientific data analysis is highly desired.
   

  

 Candidate must have demonstrated an ability in setting\-up experiments, modelling and data analysis, solving complex technical problems.
   

  

 Candidate must have demonstrated proficiency in scripting language (MATLAB, Python, others) for scientific data collection \& analysis.
   

  

 Finally, the candidate must have excellent communication, interpersonal skills and ability to create effective technical presentations.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Work within the engineering team on designing new or improving designs of existing electron\-beam imaging products for the semiconductor equipment market.
   

  

 The product subsystems include light optics, electron optics, imaging, detectors, HV electronics, vacuum systems, wafer transfer systems, detection and classification algorithms, machine control and UI software.
   

  

 The candidate is expected to gain a detailed functional understanding of the entire product, act independently, devise and drive innovative analyses and solutions for complex problems.
   

  

 Activities will include development of new designs by specifying SW / Algo / HW requirements followed by characterization, product integration and maintenance.

 Dual Degree with 2 years relevant experience or Doctorate

title: Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced and proactive
 **Senior SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) Functional Consultant** 
 to serve as a subject matter expert in Direct Procurement within the automotive/manufacturing domain. This role will lead the end\-to\-end requisition\-to\-order (RTO) stream, translating complex manufacturing supply chain needs into robust, scalable SAP S/4HANA and Fiori configurations.
   

  

*The Senior SAP MM Functional Consultant will drive activities across the full implementation lifecycle:*
* Requirements Engineering \& Business Analysis: Lead discovery workshops, conduct Fit/Gap analyses between standard S/4HANA capabilities and Ford's Direct Procurement processes, and document user stories, Epics, and functional requirements.
* Functional Design \& Architecture: Author comprehensive Functional Design Documents (FDDs) for direct material procurement workflows, including Scheduling Agreements (LP/LPA), Purchase Orders, Directed Tier\-2 sourcing, Subcontracting, and Intercompany stock transfers.
* Technical Collaboration \& Build Oversight: Partner with technical software engineering teams (ABAP, SAP Fiori / UI5, Google Cloud Platform / PCF integration middleware) to translate functional requirements into high\-quality technical deliverables; review Technical Design Documents (TDDs) and code handoffs.
* Legacy Integration \& Ecosystem Interoperability: Design and validate integration points between SAP S/4HANA MM and Ford's legacy non\-SAP manufacturing, planning, bill of materials (BOM), and warehouse systems, as well as SAP Ariba (Sourcing \& Supply Chain Collaboration).
* End\-to\-End Testing \& Defect Resolution: Architect and execute test strategies covering Functional Unit Testing (FUT), System Integration Testing (SIT), Security/Authorization validation, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT); drive root\-cause analysis and defect triage.
* Data Migration \& Cutover Readiness: Support master data profiling, cleansing, field mapping, and validation for Direct Procurement data entities (Material Masters, Business Partners/Vendors, Info Records, Source Lists, Quota Arrangements). Assist in cutover simulation and go\-live deployment.
* Process Governance \& SME Roadmap: Act as Direct Procurement SME to define global template design standards for Ford's automotive manufacturing plants, mitigating localized custom code and ensuring alignment with Clean Core principles.
* Change Enablement \& Post Go\-Live Support: Develop end\-user training materials, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and deliver hypercare and steady\-state stabilization across global deployment waves.


**Technical \& Functional Competencies**
* Core SAP S/4HANA MM Expertise: Deep functional and configuration knowledge of Direct Material Requisitioning, Automated PO Generation, Scheduling Agreements with Release Documentation (FRC/JIT delivery schedules), Evaluated Receipt Settlement (ERS), Subcontracting, Consignment, and Intercompany STO.
* Automotive / Manufacturing Direct Procurement: Comprehensive grasp of automotive supply chain dynamics, plant\-floor logistics interfaces, JIT/JIS procurement, directed component tiers (Tier\-1 / Directed Tier\-2 flows), and plant inventory valuation.
* Integration Knowledge: Strong cross\-module integration understanding across SAP MM\-PP (MRP / Material Requirements Planning), MM\-SD/LE (Logistics Execution / Inbound Deliveries), MM\-FI/CO (Account Determination, GR/IR clearing, Product Costing), and MM\-QM (Quality Inspection / Goods Receipt).
* Modern SAP Ecosystem: Proficiency with SAP Fiori role\-based apps, SAP Ariba Strategic Sourcing \& Supply Chain Collaboration (SCC), B2B EDI communication (EDIFACT/ANSI X12 via IDocs, APIs, OData services), and SAP Activate agile delivery methodology.
* Total Professional Experience: 7 to 10 years of overall IT / enterprise application implementation experience.
* SAP Functional MM Experience: 5 to 7 years of hands\-on functional design, configuration, and testing experience in SAP MM.
* Full Lifecycle Implementations: Demonstrated participation in at least 1–2 full lifecycle implementations of SAP S/4HANA (Greenfield, Brownfield, or Central Finance/iERP deployment) including Fiori interface rollout.
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mechanical/Industrial Engineering, Business Information Technology, or related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Leadership \& Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional global teams (IT, business stakeholders, system integrators), facilitate requirements workshops, and communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical leaders.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical, diagnostic, and root\-cause analysis mindset with meticulous attention to detail.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

title: Associate Architect
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
 At Presidio, we’re at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting\-edge digital solutions and next\-generation AI. We empower businesses—and their customers—to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
   

  

**The Role**
**Strategic Ownership \& Leadership**
* Own and manage the cloud ecosystem across AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring they operate with high efficiency, strong governance, and predictable costs.
* Lead a small team of cloud engineers, guiding and coaching them in roadmap creation, prioritization, execution, and skills development.
* Act as a strategic advisor to engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders on sandbox governance, usage patterns, and optimization strategies.
* Establish and enforce policies for onboarding, offboarding, resource lifecycle, and access management for users.


**Operational Excellence \& Automation**
* Design and implement automation for sandbox provisioning, quota management, access approval workflows, scheduling, and spin\-up/spin\-down processes.
* Develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Cloud\-native tools) for repeatable lab operations.\[MS1]
* Create self\-service capabilities and guardrails for sandbox users to reduce manual effort and improve governance.
* Collaborate on lab, demo, and proof of concept engagements with internal and external stakeholders.


**FinOps, Cost Governance \& Optimization**
* Implement a FinOps\-aligned operating model for all accounts including tagging standards, cost allocation, budget enforcement, and showback/chargeback across all clouds.
* Continuously analyze cloud spend trends, forecast usage, and proactively identify opportunities for rightsizing, decommissioning, and efficiency improvements.
* Build automation for policy\-based cleanup of unused/idle resources.


**Security, Governance \& Compliance**
* Define and implement security guardrails, baseline configurations, identity/access rules, and monitoring policies for sandbox environments.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance controls and enforce boundaries between sandbox and production environments.
* Implement monitoring dashboards, alerts, and operational metrics to ensure visibility and control.


**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively introduce new approaches, tools, and technologies to make lab and demo operations more efficient, secure, and cost\-effective.
* Conduct periodic reviews of account usage patterns to identify opportunities for consolidation, automation, or architectural improvements.
* Partner with cloud providers, vendors, and internal teams to evaluate new services and establish best practices.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or cloud operations roles, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or team lead position.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and working knowledge of the other two.
* Demonstrated experience in managing large or multi\-tenant cloud environments, including governance, account/projects/subscription management.
* Strong automation experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Understanding of Cloud Networking Concepts, such as AWS VPCs, Transit Gateways, Azure VNets, Public DNS with AWS Route 53 and VPN tunnel creation from the hyperscaler side.
* Familiarity with Cloud Compute and Storage such as EC2 Instances, Azure Virtual Machines, Google Compute Engine, AWS S3/EBS/EFS and/or Azure Disk Storage
* Proven expertise in FinOps, cloud cost governance, and optimization frameworks.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, guardrails, monitoring, and policy management.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications: AWS Solutions Architect / Azure Architect Expert / GCP Professional Cloud Architect.
* Prior experience in managing demo or lab environments, platform engineering, or multi\-cloud landing zones.
* Experience with cost analytics tools (CloudHealth, Flexera, Cloud Custodian, Kubecost, native cost tools).
* Knowledge of container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD workflows.
* Exposure to Cloud Centers of Excellence (CCoE) or platform engineering teams.


**Your future at Presidio**
 Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers—thinkers, builders, and collaborators—who push the boundaries of what’s possible. With our expertise in AI\-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next\-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data\-driven transformation, you’ll be part of a team that is shaping the future.
   

  

**Ready to innovate? Let’s redefine what’s next—together.**
**About Presidio**
 At Presidio, speed and quality meet technology and innovation. Presidio is a trusted ally for organizations across industries with a decades\-long history of building traditional IT foundations and deep expertise in AI and automation, security, networking, digital transformation, and cloud computing. Presidio fills gaps, removes hurdles, optimizes costs, and reduces risk. Presidio’s expert technical team develops custom applications, provides managed services, enables actionable data insights and builds forward\-thinking solutions that drive strategic outcomes for clients globally.
 **For more information, visit www.presidio.com** 
**.**
 Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.
   

  

***Recruitment Agencies, Please Note:***
 Presidio does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Do not forward resumes/CVs to our careers email address, Presidio employees or any other means. Presidio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

title: Product Security and Privacy Architect
description:
****An Amazing Career Opportunity for Product Security and Privacy Architect**
**Location: Chennai, India (Hybrid)**
**Job ID: 47565****
**Profile Summary:**
 As part of the Product Security and Privacy team, reporting to the Chief Product Security \& Privacy Architect, you will support product teams in adopting and implementing HID’s security and privacy program.
   

  

 Accountable for the quality, consistency, and defensibility of all security \& privacy related artifacts you guarantee that outputs are “audit\-ready,” and not just “done.
   

  

 You will have opportunities to work on a very wide portfolio of applications based on different technologies (Web, Embedded, Mobile, Desktop) within a very diverse and international context covering all five HID Business Areas.
   

  

**About HID Global**
 HID Global powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things. We make it possible for people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. Our trusted identity solutions give people secure and convenient access to physical and digital places and connect things that can be accurately identified, verified and tracked digitally. Millions of people around the world use HID products and services to navigate their everyday lives, and over 2 billion things are connected through HID. We work with governments, educational institutions, hospitals, financial institutions, industrial businesses, and some of the most innovative companies on the planet. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, HID Global has over 4500 employees worldwide and operates international offices that support more than 100 countries. HID Global® is an ASSA ABLOY Group brand. HID Global has is the trusted source for secure identity solutions for millions of customers and users around the world. In India, we have two Engineering Centre (Bangalore and Chennai). Global Engineering Team is based in Chennai and one of the Business Unit Engineering team is based in Bangalore. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
   

  

 LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/
   

  

**Are You Ready to Join the Team?**
 Our company is committed to finding the best and the brightest talent to help us reach the top. If you are a dynamic, highly skilled, experienced Cloud engineer and technology enthusiast, and you enjoy working in a rapid pace within a rapidly growing business environment, then you will want to consider this position. If you excel at communication, collaboration, and unrelenting innovation, we want to talk to you. And if you bring dedication, positive energy and integrity to the table, you just might be the right fit for our team.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities (Other Duties May Be Assigned)**
* Leads day\-to\-day security/privacy architecture governance, escalates and obtains approval from the Chief Product Security \& Privacy Architect as required.
* Define corporate wide security and privacy requirements, controls, and standards.
* Define corporate wide Secure Coding, third\-party, deployment policies \& other architecture\-related standards.
* Define required training content.
* Define paved roads/security and privacy\-by\-design patterns and libraries.
* Lead development of AI\-enabled PSP Architecture capabilities: define use cases, requirements, and success criteria.
* Own the threat modeling framework and quality bars.
* Run/approve security \& privacy architecture reviews.
* Lead audit/assessment planning, evidence of expectations, and defensibility.
* Responsible for tooling selection and integration related to security \& privacy architecture domain.
* Architect for compliance, analyze new regulations and standards to identify gaps in the platform's capabilities, standards, and controls.
* Assess New Acquisitions Architecture and contribute to due diligence on a needed basis.


**Primary Duties:**
 These define the broader responsibilities and areas of ownership within the role
   

  

* Provide recommendations for risk acceptance and exception requests.
* Provide input on tooling strategy and integration guidance for non\-architecture related domains.
* Provide guidance on security requirements for supply chain tooling, pipeline architecture, and associated standards.
* Validate that platform architecture enables enforcement of PSP security controls.
* Provide expert input on exploitability, attack paths, and mitigation options during Incident handling process
* Provide guidance on true risk vs noise for security tool outputs and penetration tests.
* Provide subject\-matter depth during training delivery: advanced Q\&A, edge cases, Offer office hours or follow\-ups for complex topics


**Technical Skills:** 
  

  

* Experience contributing to at least one Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDL) program, either as a security architect, security champion, or similar role.
* Working knowledge of general principles of application security
* Working knowledge of threat modeling principles.
* Working Knowledge of security standards (OWASP, ISO, NIST, ...).
* Knowledge of security regulations, such as the Radio Equipment Directive (RED), Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS), and Common Criteria (CC) or equivalent.
* Good understanding of cryptographic principles, including algorithms, key management, and protocols.
* Experience using security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, Vulnerability Scanners, Secret Scanners).
* Hands\-on experience in at least one, preferably more, of these application domains:
+ Embedded device Security
+ Mobile security
+ Web \& API security
+ Desktop security.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Cloud infrastructure, Supply Chain, and deployment Security
* Experience with Agile/SAFe Methodology
* Experience with usage of AI tools in the context of a security program.


**Education And/or Experience**
* Master's Degree, computer science, or similar qualifications.
* At least 3 years in software/product security, application security, or security architecture
* At least 7 years of hands\-on software engineering / QA / DevOps earlier in career (or equivalent).
* At least one security or privacy certification (CISSP, CIPT, CSSLP, CEH, ...) is a plus.
* Proven ownership of at least one of: threat modeling program, secure design review governance, audit evidence management, security tooling strategy, penetration testing program or similar.


**Soft Skills**
* Ability to effectively communicate complex concepts clearly and effectively in the English language, both verbally and in writing.
* Like training and knowledge\-sharing, with a strong motivation to ensure the security program is successfully implemented by the teams.
* Highly adaptable and approachable, fostering collaboration and open communication.
* Ability to tailor your communication to different audiences such as product owners, development teams, architects, and other high\-level users.
* Strong technical acumen with the ability to engage effectively with development teams and Continuous learning mindset.


****Why apply?****
* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part\-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results\-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves to feel appreciated and accepted.


 This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.
   

  

 HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation.
   

  

**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
 On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
   

  

 When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: SAP ABAP TM
description:
**Job Summary**
 The consultant is responsible for analyzing banking legal and payment requirements designing the payment file structure using transaction DMEE/DMEEX and ensuring seamless integration with the SAP Automatic Payment Program (F110/F111\).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* DMEE Tree Design \& Configuration\- Build and maintain custom DMEE tree structures (PAYM SWIFT SEPA) to meet specific banking format requirements.
* Bank Communication Support\- Collaborate with treasury/AP teams and banking partners to define file layouts mapping data from SAP to bank\-required formats.
* Field Mapping \& Logic\- Map SAP structures (FPAYH FPAYHX FPAYP) to file nodes including constants aggregation (e.g. total amount) and conditions.
* Exit Modules Implementation\- Work with ABAP developers to create and assign user exits (e.g. ZDMEE\_EXIT\_TEMPLATE\_ABA) for complex logic that cannot be achieved via standard configuration.
* PMW Configuration\- Configure Payment Medium Workbench (OBPM1 OBPM2 OBPM3 OBPM4\) to link payment methods to DMEE formats.
* Testing \& Troubleshooting\- Perform unit testing troubleshoot payment file errors using DMEE trace tools and assist in User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* S/4HANA Migration\- Upgrade traditional RFFO\* programs to modern DMEEX/PMW structures.


**Technical Skills Required**
* Expertise in DMEE/DMEEX\- Hands\-on experience with transaction codes DMEE/DMEEX.
* Understanding of PMW\- In\-depth knowledge of Payment Medium Workbench (OBPM1\-OBPM4\).
* Data Structures\- Knowledge of SAP payment tables (FPAYH \- Payment Header FPAYP \- Payment Items).
* Technical Familiarity\- Understanding of XML flat file formats and basic ABAP for Debugging/Exit Modules.
* Functional Knowledge\- Strong knowledge of SAP FICO (Accounts Payable Cash Management Bank Accounting).

title: Principal Statistical Programmer
description:
Principal Statistical Programmer is responsible for providing leadership and hands\-on support in the development and maintenance of the clients statistical programming capabilities which is required to meet regulatory obligations.
 



 Principal Statistical Programmer will work closely with the Associate Director, Director, and Statistical Programmers to build internal programming tools. This individual, working closely with the study team will be responsible for review and acceptance of contract research organization (CRO) deliverables which are mainly, but not limited to, datasets in submission ready standard format (ADaM), tables, figures, listings and submission packages. Principal Statistical Programmer will provide expertise in the design, development and quality control process for SAS programs used to access, extract, transform, review, analyze and submit clinical data for all requested analyses
 



  
 



                        Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 


* Hands on programming role, supporting deliverables in the study/project/portfolio/standards team, of medium or high complex statistical programming deliverables.
* Mentored/Guided by Statistical Programming Leads within Standards/Study /Project/ Portfolio /TA’s.
* Guide, mentor, monitor programmers within the team and collaborate with SPLs on timelines, resource management and deliverables with quality.
* Ensure adherence to programming standards in their daily work.
* Ensure the tasks are completed on time with quality and are compliant to the process at VAICS Consulting with needed guidance.
* Work collaboratively with study teams and stakeholders such as clinicians and statisticians on milestones and deliverables.
* Active self\-learning and delivering on solutions in the space of statistical programming and data standards.
* Accountable for multiple projects/ongoing work activities (timelines, work plans, deliverables) of moderate complexity within a Work Team.
* Accountable for their assigned work supporting the standards/study deliverables and also assisting SPLs with the team assignments.
* Develop/Validate/Review datasets, TFL as per CDISC aligned Standards or Data Standards for Study/Project/Portfolio. (Portfolio).
* Explore the existing code base and execute/perform runs as required, also develop/modify/review as per the needs and specifications suggested to the standards team as appropriate – (Standards).
* Understand/Implement standard/study/project/portfolio requirements and specification and work with global stakeholders in ensuring completion of project/study/deliverable goals and milestones.
* Ensures appropriate documentation are completed for their deliverables and the deliverables within the team.
* Regularly update leads on progress and time estimations to ensure smooth daily operations and accurate planning.
* Advance job knowledge to next level by participating/contributing in/to opportunities both globally and locally.
* Acts as mentor to junior team members.



 Job Qualification
 


* Bachelor or Master (preferred) Degree in Statistics, Biological Sciences, IT, or related field.
* At least 7 years relevant experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO, or Regulatory Agency.
* Statistical Programming and SAS hand\-on experience.
* Clinical trials expertise with an understanding of data operations required for the reporting of clinical trial data.
* Good understanding of ICH and regulatory guidelines.
* Working knowledge of clinical data and relevant data standards.
* Ability to Identify and solve complex problems.
* Exposure working across boundaries, with various stake holders.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, and project management skills.
* Proven ability to operate with limited oversight
* Knowledge of at least 3 Therapeutic Area (including oncology)
* Proven ability to manage delivery under tight timelines.
* CDISC and submission experience desirable.
* ISS/ISE/Submissions/RTQ's
* Familiarity with agile ways of working
* R programming experience is a plus

description:

 Build systems that shape credit decisions—at scale.
   

  

 Join a fast\-moving Credit Risk Technology team where modern engineering, data, and AI come together to drive real\-world financial impact. We operate with a startup mindset—ownership, speed, and experimentation—within the rigor and responsibility of a global financial institution. You’ll help design and deliver mission\-critical platforms that support credit risk assessment, analytics, and decisioning across the firm.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 The Credit Risk Applications Technology Lead Analyst is a senior engineering leadership role focused on building and evolving modern, scalable platforms for credit risk management. You will lead application design and development while partnering closely with risk, data, and platform teams to deliver systems that are performant, resilient, and compliant.
   

  

 This role blends hands\-on development, system architecture, technical leadership, and AI\-enabled innovation, with a strong emphasis on microservices, cloud\-native design, and enterprise\-grade governance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect, design, and deliver scalable, Python\-based applications supporting credit risk analytics, workflows, and reporting.
* Partner with risk, product, and technology leadership to integrate platforms, identify enhancements, and enable new products and process improvements.
* Resolve high\-impact, complex initiatives through deep analysis of business processes, system flows, and industry standards.
* Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise architecture, data, security, and infrastructure blueprints.
* Establish and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, CI/CD, debugging, and production readiness.
* Design and evolve microservices\-based architectures, ensuring scalability, resiliency, observability, and maintainability.
* Apply AI and GenAI capabilities to modernize workflows, automate analysis, and unlock new insights in credit risk.
* Serve as technical leader and mentor, coaching mid\-level engineers and analysts and allocating work as needed.
* Apply sound risk and control judgment, ensuring compliance with laws, regulations, and policies while safeguarding clients, data, and the firm.


**How You’ll Work**
* Operate with a startup mindset: ownership, bias for action, and pragmatic innovation.
* Deliver with enterprise discipline: stability, controls, transparency, and audit readiness.
* Balance experimentation with responsibility in a high\-trust, high\-impact environment.
* Adapt quickly as priorities change while maintaining long\-term system integrity.


**Core Technical Skills**
* 10–15 years of experience in application development or systems engineering within complex environments.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Hands\-on experience building API\-driven services using FastAPI, Pydantic, and/or Django.
* Proven expertise designing and implementing microservices architectures, including service decomposition, inter\-service communication, resiliency patterns, and observability.
* Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes, deploying and operating containerized services in production.
* Deep understanding of system architecture, data flows, and distributed systems.
* Experience working in Linux environments, including shell scripting and operational troubleshooting.
* Strong track record implementing unit testing, TDD, and automated quality controls.
* Subject Matter Expert (SME) in at least one application, platform, or service domain.

* Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs) and modern AI platforms from leading providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta.
* Experience designing or contributing to LLM\-enabled solutions (e.g., copilots, workflow automation, analytics augmentation).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, model integration patterns, and AI governance considerations in enterprise environments.
* Exposure to modern “vibe coding” practices—leveraging AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate development, experimentation, and problem solving while maintaining engineering rigor.


 Bonus / Differentiating Skills
   

  

* Experience with distributed data and compute platforms (e.g., Spark, PySpark, Hadoop, Hive).
* Hands\-on experience with graph databases, particularly Neo4j, for network, relationship, or dependency\-driven use cases.
* Background in credit risk, financial risk management, or banking platforms.
* Experience modernizing or decomposing legacy monolithic systems in large enterprises.
* Proven delivery of GenAI / AI\-driven solutions in regulated or large\-scale environments.


**Education**
 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.
   

  

 Master’s degree preferred.

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI\-driven IAM governance including risk\-based authentication, risk\-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit\-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non\-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive\-ready recommendations.

title: Lead/Senior SQA Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Our Mission:**
 We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.
   

  

**About Us**
 Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.


**Test Strategy \& Coverage**
* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.


**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**
* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.


**Functional \& Workflow Testing**
* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.


**XML and Publishing Validation**
* Perform validation of XML\-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.


**Data Layer Testing**
* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.


**API and Integration Testing**
* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook\-based integrations and event\-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.


**Performance and Reliability Testing**
* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.


**Collaboration \& Execution**
* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.


**Experience And Skills**
**Mandatory Requirements \& Qualifications** 
 :
   

  

* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML\-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands\-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven, and webhook\-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education: MCA / Bachelor’s in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications**
* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation.
* Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL).
* Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG \& EAA compliance).
* Proficiency with Git and version control systems.
* Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.
* Exposure to cloud\-based testing environments (AWS/Azure).
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).
